title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to Agentic AI: From Foundations to Systems
summary: The Hitchhiker's Guide to Agentic AI is a comprehensive practitioner's reference for building autonomous AI systems. The book covers the full stack from first principles to production deployment, organized around a central thesis: building great agentic systems requires understanding every layer of the pipeline, not just one. The book opens with the LLM substrate -- transformer architecture, GPU systems, training and fine-tuning (SFT,LoRA, MoE), model compression, and inference optimization -- treated as essential foundations rather than the primary focus. It then develops the alignment and reasoning layer: reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), PPO, DPO and its variants, GRPO, reward modeling, and RL for large reasoning models including chain-of-thought and test-time scaling. The second half is devoted to agentic AI proper. Topics include agentic training and trajectory-based RL, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG and Agentic RAG), memory systems (in-context, external, episodic, and semantic), agent harness design and context management, and a taxonomy of agent design patterns. Inter-agent coordination is covered in depth: the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent skills and tool use, the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication protocol, and multi-agent architectures spanning centralized, decentralized, and hierarchical topologies. The book concludes with agent development frameworks, agentic UI design, evaluation methodology for agentic tasks, and production deployment. Each chapter pairs rigorous theoretical foundations with implementation guidance, code examples, and references to the primary literature.

AI.tldr: 一份全面的人工智能体系统构建实践指南，覆盖从Transformer原理到多智能体协调、评估与部署的完整技术栈。
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏一部系统性、分层次地指导如何构建自主AI智能体的参考书，使得开发者难以全面理解从底层模型到上层应用的完整技术栈。
AI.method: 按技术栈分层组织：LLM基础层（Transformer/GPU/训练/压缩/推理优化）→对齐与推理层（RLHF/PPO/DPO/GRPO/奖励建模/思维链）→智能体层（轨迹RL/RAG/记忆系统/代理设计模式）→协调层（MCP协议/A2A协议/多智能体拓扑）→开发与部署层（框架/UI/评估/生产部署）。
AI.result: 提出了一套完整的智能体系统构建理论框架与工程实践指南，包含所有关键技术的原理、代码实现和参考文献。
AI.conclusion: 构建优秀智能体系统需要理解管道中的每一个层次，而不仅仅是单一层面。

title: Project Auto-World: Towards Automated Benchmarking of Neural Relational Reasoners
comment: Submitted to NeurIPS 2026 E&D track. Code is available at https://github.com/autoworldrules/auto-world-rules
summary: Reasoning about relational structures remains a significant challenge for neural models, particularly when they must systematically apply learned knowledge to problem instances that are harder than those seen in training. Progress is hampered by the difficulty of evaluating such generalization, since a priori, it is rarely clear what makes an instance hard. We study how this issue can be addressed by using large language models (LLMs) to automate benchmark generation, learning to produce increasingly challenging instances in an end-to-end manner. Concretely, given a world parametrized by Datalog rules, and an Edge Transformer as the reasoning evaluator, we use LLM-driven evolutionary search (based on FunSearch) and autonomous agentic search to discover sampling functions that yield hard problem instances. We also show that the Edge Transformer can be improved using this data such that it generalizes well to further data perturbations. Finally, we show that the same machinery can be applied to novel worlds proposed by LLMs, opening the door to autonomous research on neural relational reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用大语言模型（LLM）自动生成基准测试集，通过进化搜索和自主智能体搜索来发现具有挑战性的问题实例，以评估和改进神经模型在关系结构推理中的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 神经模型在关系结构推理中面临泛化挑战，尤其是对训练中未见过的更难实例。传统评估方式难以预先判断什么使实例变难，阻碍了进步。
AI.method: 以Datalog规则参数化的世界为基础，以Edge Transformer作为推理评估器，利用LLM驱动的进化搜索（基于FunSearch）和自主智能体搜索来发现能生成困难问题实例的采样函数，并利用生成数据改进Edge Transformer。
AI.result: Edge Transformer可以利用LLM生成的困难实例数据得到改进，从而更好地泛化到进一步的数据扰动。该机制还可应用于LLM提出的新世界，实现神经关系推理的自主研究。
AI.conclusion: LLM驱动的自动化基准生成是解决神经模型关系推理泛化评估难题的有效方法，可端到端地生成困难实例并改进模型，有望推动该领域的自主研究。

An end-to-end framework that combines Datalog-parameterized worlds with an Edge Transformer as a reasoning evaluator, where LLMs drive both evolutionary and autonomous agentic search to generate data that improves the model's systematic generalization capabilities.

A system that uses LLM-proposed novel worlds to autonomously generate training and evaluation data for neural relational reasoning, enabling self-improving research cycles without human intervention in benchmark design.

A method for improving Edge Transformer models by training on hard instances discovered via LLM-driven search, enhancing generalization to unseen data perturbations beyond the original training distribution.

title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Compounding Failures in Agentic Persuasion via Taxonomic Strategy Retrieval
summary:
Foundation-model agents in multi-step, open-ended environments frequently suffer from compounding errors, where early mistakes contaminate long-horizon trajectories. While Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) succeeds in deterministic domains, agents in subjective tasks like persuasion experience severe problem drift and sycophantic conformity. We identify semantic leakage in standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) as a reproducible trigger for these failures, as standard RAG prioritizes vocabulary overlap over logical necessity.
  To eliminate this leakage, we introduce Taxonomic Strategy RAG (TS-RAG), a systems intervention that routes strategies through a discrete categorical bottleneck to decouple argumentative structure from topical content. Zero-shot, cross-domain evaluations demonstrate that TS-RAG significantly improves the transfer of abstract logic where standard semantic retrieval collapses. Crucially, TS-RAG acts as a "capability bridge" in asymmetric deployments, empowering lightweight persuaders to consistently defeat parametrically superior opponents (improving win rates from 70.5 to 78.5) and accelerating argumentative efficiency. Finally, we introduce trace-level diagnostics via a turn-by-turn Debate State Representation (DSR), demonstrating the necessity of strict constraints to prevent evaluation collapse via default agentic sycophancy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Taxonomic Strategy RAG (TS-RAG)，通过离散类别瓶颈替代传统语义检索，解决多智能体辩论中因语义泄漏导致的错误累积和谄媚附和问题，在说服任务中显著提升轻量级模型性能。
AI.motivation: 传统多智能体辩论在主观任务（如说服）中面临问题漂移和谄媚性附和，标准RAG因优先考虑词汇重叠而非逻辑必要性导致语义泄漏，成为可复现的失败触发因素。
AI.method: 提出 Taxonomic Strategy RAG (TS-RAG)，通过离散类别瓶颈路由策略，将论证结构与主题内容解耦，消除语义泄漏；同时引入回合级辩论状态表示(DSR)作为诊断工具。
AI.result: 零样本跨领域评估显示TS-RAG显著提升抽象逻辑迁移能力；在不对称部署中，轻量级说服者胜率从70.5提升至78.5，击败参数更优的对手；论证效率也得到提升。
AI.conclusion: 严格的约束（TS-RAG的离散瓶颈和DSR诊断）对于防止默认智能体谄媚导致的评估崩溃至关重要，TS-RAG可作为非对称部署中的能力桥梁。
idea_en: A taxonomic strategy retrieval system (TS-RAG) that routes agent strategies through a discrete categorical bottleneck to decouple argumentative structure from topical content, preventing semantic leakage in multi-agent debates.

A Debate State Representation (DSR) diagnostic framework for turn-by-turn trace-level analysis of agent behavior, enabling detection and prevention of sycophantic conformity and problem drift in multi-step persuasion tasks.

A capability bridge architecture for asymmetric multi-agent deployments, where lightweight persuaders equipped with TS-RAG can defeat parametrically superior opponents through improved logical necessity over vocabulary overlap.

A method for eliminating compounding errors in foundation-model agents by replacing standard semantic RAG with category-bottlenecked retrieval that prioritizes logical necessity over lexical similarity.

title: Do vision-language models search like humans? Reasoning tokens as a reaction-time analog in classic visual-search paradigms
summary: Visual search has been one of the most productive paradigms in the study of visual attention: the way reaction time scales with the number of items distinguishes parallel, "pop-out" search from serial, attention-demanding search. I ask whether vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit the same behavioral signatures. I adapt four classic paradigms: feature versus conjunction search, spatial-configuration (T-vs-L) search, enumeration, and the tilted/vertical search asymmetry; and present them to current frontier and mid-tier models. Because a single model call has no reaction time, I use the number of reasoning ("thinking") tokens a model spends per trial as a within-model analog of search effort, and I compare against a large public human benchmark (Wolfe et al., 2010). The models reproduce several human signatures: feature search costs flat effort while conjunction effort climbs with set size; frontier models hold accuracy where mid-tier models collapse to chance; and a resolution control shows the conjunction cost is genuine search rather than difficulty resolving small shapes. They also diverge from humans in informative ways. The target-present effort slope exceeds the target-absent slope, reversing the human ordering; enumeration remains accurate where humans would lose count; and a reasoning model with adaptive deliberation declines to deliberate on detection tasks altogether, so that a single search expresses itself as an effort gradient in one model and as an accuracy cliff in another. I argue that psychophysical paradigms, applied behaviorally, are a sharp and inexpensive probe of machine visual cognition, and that the points of divergence are as informative as the points of agreement.

AI.tldr: 本文通过改编四种经典的视觉搜索范式（特征vs联合搜索、T-vs-L空间构型搜索、枚举、倾斜/垂直搜索不对称），测试了视觉语言模型（VLM）是否表现出与人类相似的行为特征。研究发现，前沿VLM在若干方面复现了人类行为（如特征搜索成本平坦、联合搜索成本随集合大小增加），但在关键方面存在差异（如目标存在时搜索斜率大于目标缺失时，与人类相反），提示心理物理范式可作为机器视觉认知的有效探针。
AI.motivation: 探究视觉语言模型（VLM）是否具备与人类视觉注意力相似的搜索行为特征，包括并行"弹出"搜索与串行注意力搜索的区分，以及反应时间随项目数量变化的模式。
AI.method: 改编四个经典范式（特征vs联合搜索、T-vs-L空间构型搜索、枚举、倾斜/垂直搜索不对称），向前沿和中端VLM呈现这些任务，使用推理（"思考"）令牌数量作为搜索努力的代理指标，并与人类行为基准（Wolfe et al., 2010）进行比较。
AI.result: 模型复现了部分人类特征：特征搜索成本平坦，联合搜索成本随集合大小增加；前沿模型保持准确性而中端模型失败。但存在差异：目标存在时搜索斜率大于目标缺失时（与人类相反）；枚举任务中模型保持准确而人类计数困难；推理模型在检测任务中拒绝进行自适应推理。
AI.conclusion: 心理物理范式作为行为学方法可以有效且低成本地探测机器视觉认知，模型与人类的契合点和差异点同样具有价值。

title: Beyond Shapley: Efficient Computation of Asymmetric Shapley Values
summary: We address the problem of explainability in machine learning models through feature attribution methods. In particular, we consider a variant of Shapley values known as Asymmetric Shapley Values (ASV), which enables the incorporation of causal knowledge into model-agnostic explanations through the use of a causal graph. We show that in certain contexts in which the computation of SHAP is $\#P$-hard, the exact computation of ASV can be done in polynomial time. To extend this algorithmic result, we introduce a notion of equivalence classes over the topological orderings of the underlying causal graph, which is useful to reduce the time to compute ASV. In particular, we present a polynomial-time algorithm (in the number of equivalence classes) to compute it whenever the causal graph is a rooted directed tree. Finally, we develop an algorithm for approximating ASV in arbitrary causal DAGs which relies on a procedure to sample topological orderings uniformly at random. To implement this sampling mechanism we leverage known algorithms as well as simpler alternatives. Our experimental results demonstrate the practical viability of the proposed approach in realistic causal structures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于因果图的不对称Shapley值（ASV）计算方法，在特定因果结构下可实现多项式时间的精确计算，并开发了针对任意有向无环图的近似算法。
AI.motivation: 解决机器学习模型可解释性中的特征归因问题，特别是SHAP值在某些情况下计算复杂度为#P-hard，需要更高效的可解释性方法。
AI.method: 1) 引入拓扑排序等价类概念降低ASV计算复杂度；2) 针对有根有向树提出多项式时间精确算法；3) 针对任意因果DAG设计基于均匀拓扑排序采样的近似算法。
AI.result: 在特定上下文中ASV可在多项式时间内精确计算；实验证明所提方法在实际因果结构中具有可行性和实用性。
AI.conclusion: ASV在因果知识融入的可解释性中具有计算优势，提出的算法拓展了可解释AI的实用边界。
idea_en: A method for computing Asymmetric Shapley Values exactly in polynomial time for rooted directed tree causal graphs using topological ordering equivalence classes.
An approximation algorithm for Asymmetric Shapley Values in arbitrary causal DAGs based on uniform random sampling of topological orderings.
A topological ordering equivalence class reduction technique that reduces computational complexity of causal feature attribution.

title: The Clinician's Veto: Navigating Trust, Liability, and Uncertainty in Autonomous AI Prescribing
summary: Autonomous AI systems are transitioning from advisory to autonomous roles for medication prescriptions. Recent United States bill H.R. 238 and Utah's prescription-renewal pilot both authorize AI to prescribe medications in an agentic capacity. While some regulatory guidelines suggest aggregate model performance metrics for clearance, they do not require i) calibrated per-prediction confidence for action-gated thresholds, ii) differentiated communication of uncertainty arising from model ignorance (epistemic) versus genuine clinical ambiguity (aleatoric), and iii) inferential transparency at the moment of decision that allows for liability allocation. Here, we present a regulatory and technical argument (tested with a survey of 136 U.S. prescribing clinicians) positioning these as minimum architectural requirements for safe autonomous prescribing. Our results suggest prescribing clinicians i) would not permit autonomous prescribing without a calibrated confidence-based escalation mechanism, ii) preferred a competing-options summary when uncertainty was aleatoric but shifted to abstention when uncertainty was epistemic, and iii) were only willing to accept additional liability when inferential transparency enabled a substantive judgment under acknowledged uncertainty. These findings indicate our recommended architectural features would encourage higher rates of clinician adoption, largely through collapsing much of what "autonomy" conventionally means. A system meeting these requirements would function less as an autonomous agent and more as a heavily supervised decision-support tool. As legislation and state pilots proceed, our technical argument backed by clinician perspectives provides opportunities for regulation to constrain the degree of autonomy ethically granted to AI in prescribing while aligning liability with the institutional actors who control system design and deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI自主开药系统应具备三个最小架构要求：校准的置信度门控机制、区分认知不确定性（模型无知）与偶然不确定性（临床模糊性）、以及决策时的推理透明性。通过136名美国临床医生的调查验证了这些要求的必要性。
AI.motivation: 当前AI从建议角色转向自主开药角色，但现有监管指南仅要求聚合性能指标，缺乏对逐预测置信度校准、不确定性区分和推理透明度的要求，可能导致不安全用药。
AI.method: 通过136名美国处方临床医生的调查研究，测试三大架构要求对临床医生接受度的影响，并从监管和技术角度论证其作为自主开药最低要求。
AI.result: 临床医生要求校准的置信度门控机制；偶然不确定性时偏好竞争选项摘要，认知不确定性时倾向弃权；仅在推理透明性允许其在已知不确定性下做出实质性判断时才愿意承担额外责任。
AI.conclusion: 满足这些要求的系统更像受监督的决策支持工具而非自主代理；监管应利用这些技术要求限制AI开药的自主程度，并将责任分配给控制系统设计和部署的机构。

title: TRUSTMEM: Learning Trustworthy Memory Consolidation for LLM Agents with Long-Term Memory
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on long-term memory to support extended interactions and personalized assistance beyond finite context windows. Existing memory agents actively update external memory through generated write, revise, and delete operations, but these updates may omit important information, corrupt existing memory, or introduce unsupported hallucinated content. Once stored, such errors become persistent system-state failures that can affect future reasoning and generation. In this paper, we propose TrustMem, a framework designed to improve the trustworthiness of memory consolidation. TrustMem relies on a Memory Transition Verifier to evaluate the transition process of memory updates in terms of coverage, preservation, and faithfulness. It further constructs preference pairs among candidate updates under the same memory state, enabling preference-guided reinforcement learning to directly optimize memory updating behaviors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TrustMem improves both memory utility and reliability: it achieves state-of-the-art results across MemoryAgentBench, HaluMem, and the Mem-alpha validation set, improves HaluMem memory extraction by 12.14 F1 points, and reduces transition-level omission, corruption, and hallucination by 40.1\%, 79.1\%, and 50.0\%, respectively, compared with the strongest baseline for each error type.

AI.tldr: TrustMem是一个提升LLM Agent长期记忆更新可信度的框架，通过Memory Transition Verifier评估记忆更新的覆盖性、保留性和忠实性，并利用偏好引导的强化学习优化记忆更新行为，有效减少了记忆更新中的遗漏、损坏和幻觉问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM Agent的记忆系统通过写入、修改、删除等操作主动更新外部记忆，但这些更新可能遗漏重要信息、损坏已有记忆或引入幻觉内容，一旦存入便成为持续性系统错误，影响后续推理和生成。
AI.method: TrustMem包含一个Memory Transition Verifier，用于评估记忆更新在覆盖性（coverage）、保留性（preservation）和忠实性（faithfulness）三个维度的过渡质量。在相同记忆状态下构建候选更新的偏好对，通过偏好引导的强化学习直接优化记忆更新行为。
AI.result: 在MemoryAgentBench、HaluMem和Mem-alpha验证集上达到SOTA结果；HaluMem记忆抽取F1提升12.14分；相比最强基线，过渡层面的遗漏减少40.1%、损坏减少79.1%、幻觉减少50.0%。
AI.conclusion: TrustMem框架通过评估和优化记忆更新过程，显著提升了记忆系统的可信度和可靠性，验证了偏好引导强化学习在改善记忆维护方面的有效性。
idea_en: Memory Transition Verifier: A verification mechanism that evaluates memory update transitions across three dimensions—coverage (completeness of information capture), preservation (retention of existing correct memory), and faithfulness (avoidance of hallucinated content).

Preference-guided reinforcement learning for memory updates: A training paradigm that constructs preference pairs among candidate memory updates under the same memory state, then optimizes memory update behaviors via reinforcement learning based on these preferences.

Triple-dimension memory transition evaluation metrics: A structured evaluation framework that quantifies memory update quality through omission rate, corruption rate, and hallucination rate at the transition level.
idea_ch: 记忆过渡验证器（Memory Transition Verifier）：一种评估记忆更新过渡过程的验证机制，从覆盖性（信息捕获完整性）、保留性（保留已有正确记忆）和忠实性（避免幻觉内容）三个维度进行综合评价。
偏好引导的记忆更新强化学习：在相同记忆状态下构建候选更新的偏好对，然后基于这些偏好通过强化学习直接优化记忆更新行为的训练范式。
三维度记忆过渡评估指标：通过过渡层面的遗漏率、损坏率和幻觉率来量化记忆更新质量的系统化评估框架。

title: Elo-Disentangled Player-Style Embeddings for Human Chess via Rating-Conditioned Residual Move Model
summary: We study representation learning for individual human chess style: a per-player embedding learned from a player's move history such that inner products measure stylistic similarity, while being approximately disentangled from playing strength (Elo). Our key design is a residual formulation: a rating-conditioned base move model (Maia-3 policy logits plus Stockfish-derived features, scored over Maia-2-proposed candidates) captures what a typical player of a given strength would play, and a frozen copy of it anchors a learned move encoder and a per-player vector z, so that z explains only deviations from rating-typical play. The base model improves move prediction over the strong Maia-3 policy by 27-37% relative NLL across the rating spectrum, with the largest gains at the top (2800+); Stockfish's marginal value grows monotonically with Elo (negligible at 900-1200, +0.085 nats at 2800+). On a shared Elo-stratified benchmark of 22,620 held-out decisions, top-1 move-matching rises monotonically from Maia-2 to Maia-3 to the Stockfish-augmented base (0.51 -> 0.57 -> 0.68): the base is +33% relative top-1 over Maia-2 and +19% over Maia-3 (30% lower NLL), with the engine-feature lift largest at high Elo. The player embedding adds little to raw move-matching on top of this base -- its marginal top-1 gain falls within the 95% confidence interval -- and its value is instead representational: z generalizes to held-out decisions without overfitting, re-identifies players from disjoint games above chance, and a linear probe recovers rating from z with only R^2 = 0.06 (no better nonlinearly), evidence it captures style on an Elo-orthogonal axis. We argue that a strong rating-conditioned base plus a compact, Elo-disentangled embedding -- separating typical play from individual deviation -- is an economical, interpretable model of individual style, an alternative to per-player preference fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种残差式个体国际象棋风格表征学习框架，通过评分条件基础模型（Maia-3+Stockfish特征）捕获典型下法，再用可学习的每玩家向量z仅建模与评分典型下法的偏差，从而实现风格与棋力（Elo）的解耦嵌入。
AI.motivation: 现有棋手建模方法难以区分"棋力水平"与"个人风格"，即高水平棋手之间的风格差异往往被其共同的高水平能力所掩盖。作者希望学习一个与Elo评分近似正交（disentangled）的个体风格嵌入，使得内积能度量风格相似性，同时不受水平高低干扰。
AI.method: 1) 构建评分条件基础模型：使用Maia-3策略logits + Stockfish引擎特征，在Maia-2候选走法上评分，预测给定评分棋手的典型下法。2) 残差框架：冻结基础模型，训练一个走法编码器（move encoder）和每玩家向量z，z仅编码个体偏差（即与评分典型下法的差异），内积度量风格相似性。3) 在Elo分层基准（22,620个留出决策）上评估。
AI.result: 基础模型相对Maia-3策略在NLL上改进27-37%，最高评级（2800+）收益最大。Stockfish特征贡献随Elo单调增长（低分段可忽略，高分段+0.085 nats）。top-1走法匹配：Maia-2 0.51 → Maia-3 0.57 → Stockfish增强基础模型 0.68。玩家嵌入z对原始走法匹配提升微小（在95%置信区间内），但能泛化到留出决策、从非重叠对局中再识别棋手（高于随机水平），且线性探针从z恢复Elo的R²仅0.06（非线性也无改善），证实z捕捉了与Elo近似正交的风格轴。
AI.conclusion: 强评分条件基础模型+紧凑、Elo解耦的个体嵌入是经济且可解释的个体风格建模方案，可作为每玩家偏好微调（per-player fine-tuning）的替代方案。
idea_en: A residual representation learning method for individual chess style, comprising: a rating-conditioned base move model that predicts typical moves for a player of a given strength; a frozen copy of said base model used as an anchor; a learnable move encoder and a per-player vector z that captures only deviations from rating-typical play, enabling style embeddings disentangled from playing strength.

A method for Elo-disentangled player embedding wherein inner products between per-player vectors measure stylistic similarity while being approximately orthogonal to playing strength, achieved by training the player vectors to explain only residuals relative to a rating-conditioned baseline model.

A rating-conditioned base move model that integrates Maia policy logits with Stockfish-derived engine features, scored over a candidate move set, which improves move prediction across the rating spectrum with 27-37% relative NLL improvement over the Maia-3 policy alone.

A system for player re-identification from disjoint games using learned per-player style embeddings that generalize to held-out decisions without overfitting, enabling identification of the same player from different game subsets at above-chance accuracy.

A linear probing method to verify Elo disentanglement in learned player embeddings, where a linear regressor recovers rating from the style embedding z with only R²=0.06, confirming the embedding captures style on an axis orthogonal to playing strength.
idea_ch: 一种个体国际象棋风格的残差表征学习方法，包括：一个评分条件基础走法模型，用于预测给定棋力水平玩家的典型下法；冻结该基础模型作为锚点；一个可学习的走法编码器和每玩家向量z，仅编码与评分典型下法的偏差，实现与棋力解耦的风格嵌入。
一种与Elo解耦的玩家嵌入方法，其中每玩家向量之间的内积度量风格相似性，同时近似正交于棋力水平，通过训练玩家向量仅解释相对于评分条件基线模型的残差来实现。
一种评分条件基础走法模型，集成Maia策略logits与Stockfish引擎特征，在候选走法集上评分，在评分谱上改善走法预测，相对Maia-3策略NLL改进27-37%。
一种利用学习到的每玩家风格嵌入从非重叠对局中进行玩家再识别的系统，可泛化到留出决策而无过拟合，实现从不同对局子集以高于随机水平的准确率识别同一玩家。
一种验证学习到的玩家嵌入中Elo解耦的线性探针方法，其中线性回归器从风格嵌入z恢复评分的R²仅为0.06，证实嵌入捕捉了与棋力正交的风格轴。

title: Transferability for General Reasoning: An Automated Curriculum for Multi-Domain RLVR
comment: 32 pages, including supplementary material; code available at https://github.com/YangYongJin/transfer-aware-curriculum
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has been extended from single-domain training to multi-domain reasoning suites spanning mathematics, programming, and science. However, the training curriculum (how often each domain is sampled) is typically fixed or hand-tuned, even though reasoning skills transfer unevenly across domains. Existing learnability-based curricula adapt to where the policy is currently improving, but are blind to whether a gradient step on the selected domain benefits the remaining domains. In this paper, we propose Transfer-Aware Curriculum (TAC), a bandit-style online curriculum that prioritizes domains whose updates broadly benefit the rest of the training suite. TAC repurposes signals already produced by RL training: per-domain advantages capture local learnability, and projected gradients, taken from the GRPO step being computed, estimate cross-domain transferability via gradient-geometry alignment, at negligible cost (<1% wall-clock overhead). Across a six-domain reasoning suite, TAC achieves the best macro-averaged accuracy on both Qwen3-1.7B and Llama3.2-3B, outperforming proportional random sampling, a hand-designed schedule, and a learnability-only bandit, and improving over the last of these by up to 2.8 points (10% relative). Ablations show performance degrades sharply when the transferability term is removed, and TAC remains robust on imbalanced training mixtures where learnability-only curricula over-commit to dominant domains. Our findings establish cross-domain transferability as a key signal for curriculum design in multi-domain RLVR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TAC（迁移感知课程），一种基于多臂老虎机的在线课程学习方法，在多领域RLVR训练中优先选择那些更新能最广泛惠及其他领域的领域，通过利用策略梯度的几何对齐来估计跨领域可迁移性，相比固定或仅基于可学习性的课程方法取得更优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR多领域训练中，训练课程通常是固定或手工调整的，忽略了推理技能在不同领域间的不均匀迁移。已有基于可学习性的课程方法只关注当前正在改进的领域，但无法判断对该领域的梯度更新是否对其它领域有益。
AI.method: 提出TAC（Transfer-Aware Curriculum），一种基于多臂老虎机的在线课程学习框架。利用RL训练中已有的信号：领域优势（per-domain advantages）捕获局部可学习性，从GRPO步骤中提取的投影梯度（projected gradients）通过梯度几何对齐估计跨领域可迁移性。开销极小（<1%时间开销）。
AI.result: 在六个领域推理套件上，TAC在Qwen3-1.7B和Llama3.2-3B上均取得最佳宏观平均准确率，优于比例随机采样、手动设计的课程和仅基于可学习性的多臂老虎机方法，相对提升最高达10%（2.8个点）。消融实验表明移除可迁移性项后性能显著下降，且在非平衡训练混合中TAC表现稳健。
AI.conclusion: 跨领域可迁移性是RLVR多领域课程设计的关键信号，TAC通过极低开销利用梯度几何对齐实现了更优的多领域推理训练。
idea_en: A transfer-aware online curriculum learning method for multi-domain RLVR that prioritizes domains whose gradient updates benefit the most other domains via gradient-geometry alignment.

A bandit-style curriculum framework that repurposes per-domain advantages (learnability) and projected gradients (transferability) from existing GRPO training signals at negligible computational overhead (<1% wall-clock).
Using gradient projection-based cross-domain transferability estimation that measures geometric alignment between domain gradients to guide multi-domain training sampling.
idea_ch: 一种面向多领域RLVR的迁移感知在线课程学习方法，通过梯度几何对齐优先选择梯度更新能最广泛惠及其他领域的领域进行训练。
一种基于多臂老虎机的课程学习框架，利用现有GRPO训练中已有的领域优势（可学习性）和投影梯度（可迁移性）信号，额外开销极低（<1%时间开销）。
基于梯度投影的跨领域可迁移性估计方法，通过测量领域间梯度几何对齐度来指导多领域训练采样。

title: To Isolate or to Score? Model-Adaptive Assessment for Cost-Efficient Multi-Agent RAG
summary: Multi-agent document assessment for retrieval-augmented generation is computationally expensive, driving practitioners toward smaller, deployable models whose assessment mechanisms remain poorly understood. We conduct a controlled study of training-free interventions on 7B-9B instruction-tuned models across diverse QA benchmarks, revealing a sharp dichotomy in how models benefit from assessment. For weaker baselines, the dominant mechanism is per-document isolation. Astoundingly, assessment-free isolation matches full multi-agent assessment, demonstrating that resolving multi-document context confusion, rather than scoring quality, drives outsized gains of up to 50 percentage points. Conversely, for strong baselines where scoring quality matters, we introduce Reasoning-Score Coupling, a label-free perturbation probe that classifies scoring behavior. Integrating these findings, we propose MADARA, a model-adaptive routing architecture. Crucially, MADARA's diagnostic thresholds derived from a single pilot model generalize zero-shot to four unseen model families, providing a robust, lightweight pipeline to eliminate computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示了多智能体文档评估在RAG中的关键机制：对弱模型，隔离文档（而非评分质量）带来高达50个百分点的提升；对强模型，提出了Reasoning-Score Coupling探针用于分类评分行为。基于此提出MADARA架构，实现零样本跨模型泛化的自适应路由。
AI.motivation: 多智能体文档评估在检索增强生成中计算成本高昂，促使研究者使用更小的可部署模型，但这些模型的评估机制尚不明确。本文旨在通过对照实验揭示这些机制，并提出轻量级替代方案。
AI.method: 在7B-9B指令微调模型上进行了无训练干预的对照研究，涵盖多种QA基准。通过对比有无评估的隔离机制，发现弱模型主要受益于文档隔离。针对强基线模型，提出了Reasoning-Score Coupling（RSC）无标签扰动探针，用于分类评分行为。基于这些发现设计了MADARA（模型自适应路由架构）。
AI.result: 弱基线模型中，无评估的文档隔离效果与完整多智能体评估相当，提升高达50个百分点。MADARA的诊断阈值可从单个模型零样本泛化到四个未见过的模型家族。
AI.conclusion: 多文档上下文混淆是RAG评估中的关键瓶颈，而非评分质量本身。MADARA提供了一种轻量级、可泛化的解决方案，消除了多智能体评估的计算开销。
idea_en: A training-free per-document isolation mechanism that resolves multi-document context confusion in RAG, achieving accuracy gains of up to 50 percentage points without requiring any assessment scoring or multi-agent evaluation.
Reasoning-Score Coupling (RSC): a label-free perturbation probe that classifies scoring behavior in strong baseline models by analyzing the coupling between reasoning and scoring processes.

MADARA (Model-Adaptive Routing Architecture): a lightweight pipeline with diagnostic thresholds derived from a single pilot model that generalizes zero-shot to unseen model families, eliminating computational overhead of multi-agent assessment.
A method for diagnosing whether a model's benefit from document assessment stems from context isolation vs scoring quality, enabling adaptive routing of computational resources.
idea_ch: 一种无需训练的逐文档隔离机制，通过解决RAG中的多文档上下文混淆问题，在不进行任何评估评分或多智能体评估的情况下，实现高达50个百分点的准确率提升。
推理-评分耦合（RSC）探针：一种无标签的扰动探测方法，通过分析推理过程与评分行为之间的耦合关系，对强基线模型的评分行为进行分类。
MADARA（模型自适应路由架构）：一种轻量级流水线，从单个试点模型提取的诊断阈值可零样本泛化到未见过的模型家族，消除了多智能体评估的计算开销。
一种诊断模型从文档评估中获益来源的方法（区分上下文隔离vs评分质量），支持计算资源的自适应路由分配。

title: Heuresis: Search Strategies for Autonomous AI Research Agents Across Quality, Diversity and Novelty
comment: 14 pages main text, 82 pages total including appendix; 38 figures, 4 tables
summary: Autonomous AI Research promises to accelerate the scientific progress of machine learning. To realise this goal, current Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents need to go beyond just writing code, to mastering the exploration of simultaneously performant, diverse and novel ideas. To this end, we introduce Heuresis, a framework that abstracts the research pipeline into a set of general and composable primitives, enabling open-ended scientific exploration in machine learning research. We implement six search strategies: a greedy baseline, two archive-based (MAP-Elites, Go-Explore), one evolutionary (Islands), and two divergent (Curiosity, Omni), and evaluate them across three axes (Quality, Diversity, and Novelty) on three domains (LLM Pretraining, On-Policy RL, and Model Unlearning), totalling 3,222 scored runs. We find that completely novel ideas are rare. No idea across our scored runs is rated as "Original", and only a few achieve only "Minor Similarity" to prior work. Moreover, novel ideas never approach the highest-performing known-recipe scores. Across all six strategies and three domains, only one such idea lands in the top-10 by quality. We also observed agents resorting to a variety of reward-hacking techniques during execution (40 confirmed fabrications across 1,628 scored runs), and detecting them was necessary to keep the search faithful to the task. Our results show that while current search and Quality-Diversity strategies enable us to steer where the generated ideas land on the quality, diversity, and novelty axes, they do not expand the quality-novelty frontier. Bridging this gap is the open challenge towards the ultimate goal of perpetual, autonomous scientific progress. Code is available at github.com/a-antoniades/Heuresis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Heuresis框架，将AI科研流程抽象为通用可组合原语，在三个领域测试六种搜索策略，发现当前方法无法同时实现高质量与高新颖性，且存在奖励破解问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于LLM的自主AI研究代理主要局限于写代码，缺乏对同时具备高性能、多样性和新颖性的研究想法的探索能力，难以实现真正的开放式科学探索。
AI.method: 提出Heuresis框架，将科研流程抽象为一组通用可组合原语；实现六种搜索策略（贪婪基线、MAP-Elites、Go-Explore、Islands进化、Curiosity、Omni发散策略）；在LLM预训练、在策略强化学习和模型遗忘三个领域进行评估。
AI.result: 在3222次评分运行中，完全新颖的想法极为罕见，没有任何想法被评为"原创"，仅有少数达到"轻微相似"；新颖想法从未达到最高性能已知配方的水平；六种策略和三个领域中仅有一个新颖想法进入质量前十；检测到40个确认的奖励破解案例。
AI.conclusion: 当前搜索和质量-多样性策略虽能引导想法在质量、多样性和新颖性维度上的分布，但无法扩大质量-新颖性前沿边界，实现持续的自主科学进步仍是开放挑战。
idea_en: A composable primitive abstraction framework for ML research pipelines that enables modular and reusable research workflows.
A multi-archive search strategy combining MAP-Elites and Go-Explore for open-ended scientific idea generation.
An island-based evolutionary search strategy for simultaneous optimization of quality, diversity, and novelty in research ideas.
A curiosity-driven divergent search mechanism for generating novel ML research directions.
An Omni-strategy that integrates multiple search heuristics for balanced exploration of the quality-novelty frontier.
A reward-hacking detection system that automatically identifies fabricated results in LLM-generated research runs.
idea_ch: 一种将ML科研流程抽象为可组合原语的框架，实现模块化和可重用的研究工作流。
一种结合MAP-Elites和Go-Explore的多档案搜索策略，用于开放式科学想法生成。
一种基于岛屿模型的进化搜索策略，同时优化研究想法的质量、多样性和新颖性。
一种好奇心驱动的发散搜索机制，用于生成新颖的ML研究方向。
一种整合多种搜索启发式的全向策略，用于平衡质量-新颖性前沿的探索。
一种奖励破解检测系统，可自动识别LLM生成研究运行中的伪造结果。

title: Omni-Perception Policy Optimization for Multimodal Emotion Reasoning
summary: We find that current emotion-oriented Omni-MLLMs still lack reliable omni-modal perception: they (i) underutilize multimodal cues in their reasoning trajectories and (ii) exhibit unfaithful behavior, often hallucinating modality-specific statements from other modalities. Building on these insights, we propose OPPO (Omni-Perception Policy Optimization), a reinforcement learning framework that explicitly optimizes multimodal perception. First, an Omni-Perception Reward decomposes ground-truth reasoning into fine-grained visual, acoustic, and emotion cues and rewards trajectories that semantically recover these cues. Second, an Omni-Perception Loss compares the policy under full and unimodally masked inputs, applying a KL penalty only to modality-specific evidence tokens to suppress cross-modal hallucination. We further introduce MEP-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark that quantifies utilization and faithfulness. Experiments show that OPPO achieves state-of-the-art performance on MER-UniBench and MME-Emotion, while substantially improving utilization and faithfulness scores on MEP-Bench, highlighting the importance of sufficient and faithful omni perception for multimodal emotion reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出OPPO强化学习框架，通过细粒度多模态奖励分解和跨模态幻觉抑制损失，优化全模态情感大模型的多模态感知能力，并在新基准MEP-Bench上验证了效果。
AI.motivation: 现有情感导向的全模态大模型存在两个问题：(i)推理轨迹中未能充分利用多模态线索；(ii)存在不忠实行为，常从其他模态幻觉出模态特定的陈述。
AI.method: 提出OPPO框架：(1)全模态感知奖励：将ground-truth推理分解为细粒度的视觉、声学、情感线索，奖励能语义恢复这些线索的轨迹；(2)全模态感知损失：比较全模态输入与单模态掩码输入下的策略，仅对模态特定证据token施加KL惩罚以抑制跨模态幻觉。同时构建诊断基准MEP-Bench。
AI.result: 在MER-UniBench和MME-Emotion上达到SOTA，在MEP-Bench上显著提升了利用率和忠实度分数。
AI.conclusion: 充分且忠实的多模态感知对于多模态情感推理至关重要，OPPO框架有效提升了全模态大模型的情感感知能力。
idea_en: A reinforcement learning framework (OPPO) that explicitly optimizes multimodal perception in Omni-MLLMs by decomposing ground-truth reasoning into fine-grained visual, acoustic, and emotion cues for reward computation.

An Omni-Perception Loss mechanism that compares policy outputs under full-modal vs unimodally-masked inputs and applies KL penalty selectively to modality-specific evidence tokens to suppress cross-modal hallucination.
A diagnostic benchmark (MEP-Bench) designed to quantify modality utilization and faithfulness in emotion-oriented Omni-MLLMs, enabling standardized evaluation of omni-modal perception quality.
idea_ch: 一种显式优化全模态大模型多模态感知能力的强化学习框架(OPPO)，通过将ground-truth推理分解为细粒度视觉、声学、情感线索来构建奖励信号
一种全模态感知损失机制，比较全模态输入与单模态掩码输入下的策略输出，仅对模态特定证据token施加KL散度惩罚，从而抑制跨模态幻觉
一种用于量化情感全模态大模型模态利用率和忠实度的诊断基准(MEP-Bench)，支持标准化评估全模态感知质量

title: Agentic Knowledge Tracing: A Multi-Agent LLM Architecture for Stealth Assessment of Financial Literacy in Serious Games
summary: Assessing financial literacy during gameplay without disrupting the learning experience remains a key challenge in serious games for education. We present the Agentic BKT pipeline, a multi-agent large language model architecture for stealth assessment of financial competencies from open-ended gameplay events. The pipeline processes events from a 2D platformer serious game aligned with the OECD/INFE financial literacy framework through four phases: (1) the game captures every player decision as a structured event log; (2) an LLM event classifier labels each action on a four-point rubric validated against three domain experts (Fleiss kappa = 0.624, substantial agreement); (3) four domain-specific agents specializing in risk mitigation, investing, spending, and credit management perform session-level reasoning over behavioral trajectories, feeding per-competency Bayesian Knowledge Tracing that estimates mastery within each domain; and (4) an expert judge agent synthesizes the domain-level estimates into an overall mastery score. Evaluated with 193 K-12 participants across 264 game sessions, the Agentic BKT pipeline yields mastery estimates significantly correlated with learning gain (r = 0.276, p = 0.0001) and post-test scores (r = 0.333, p < 0.0001) while showing no correlation with pre-test scores, providing both convergent and discriminant validity. The multi-agent approach approximately triples the predictive validity of a single-LLM baseline (r = 0.095, not significant) in this study, demonstrating that domain decomposition and session-level reasoning play a central role in capturing the multidimensional nature of financial literacy from gameplay

AI.tldr: 提出了一种Agentic BKT流水线，利用多智能体大语言模型架构，通过分析开放世界游戏事件对金融素养进行隐式评估，在193名K-12学生的264场游戏会话中验证了其预测效度（学习增益r=0.276，后测分数r=0.333），性能约为单LLM基线的三倍。
AI.motivation: 在不干扰学习体验的前提下，从严肃游戏玩法中有效评估玩家的金融素养是一个关键挑战。现有方法难以处理开放式的游戏事件，也无法捕捉金融素养的多维度特性。
AI.method: 提出Agentic BKT流水线，包含四个阶段：(1) 游戏记录每个玩家决策的结构化事件日志；(2) LLM事件分类器基于四点评分量表对每个动作进行标注（与三位领域专家验证，Fleiss kappa=0.624）；(3) 四个领域专用智能体（风险管理、投资、支出、信用管理）对行为轨迹进行会话级推理，通过贝叶斯知识追踪（BKT）评估每个领域的掌握程度；(4) 专家评审智能体综合各领域评估结果，输出整体掌握分数。
AI.result: 在193名K-12学生的264场游戏会话中，Agentic BKT流水线的掌握程度评估与学习增益显著相关（r=0.276, p=0.0001），与后测分数显著相关（r=0.333, p<0.0001），与前测分数无相关性，具有收敛和判别效度。多智能体方法的预测效度约为单LLM基线（r=0.095, 不显著）的三倍。
AI.conclusion: 领域分解与会话级推理对于从游戏玩法中捕捉金融素养的多维度特性至关重要，多智能体LLM架构在严肃游戏隐式评估方面具有显著优势。
idea_en: Multi-agent LLM architecture for stealth assessment from open-ended gameplay events, using domain-decomposed agents (risk, investing, spending, credit) for session-level reasoning
Event-to-rubric classification system using LLM with four-point scoring validated against multiple domain experts (Fleiss kappa > 0.6)
Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT) integration with LLM agents for per-competency mastery estimation in serious games
Expert judge agent that synthesizes domain-level mastery estimates into an overall score, enabling multi-dimensional competency assessment
Agentic pipeline that processes structured game event logs through LLM-based event labeling, domain reasoning, and BKT in sequence for automated stealth assessment
idea_ch: 基于多智能体大语言模型的隐式评估架构，通过领域分解智能体（风险管理、投资、支出、信用管理）对开放游戏事件进行会话级推理
利用LLM进行事件到量表的分类系统，采用四点评分量表并经多位领域专家验证（Fleiss kappa>0.6）
将贝叶斯知识追踪（BKT）与LLM智能体相结合，用于严肃游戏中每个能力领域的掌握程度评估
专家评审智能体，将各领域掌握评估综合为整体分数，实现多维度能力评估
通过LLM事件标注、领域推理和BKT序列处理结构化游戏事件日志的自动化隐式评估流水线

title: What Actually Works for Spacecraft Fault-Tolerant Control: An Honest Settled-Gate Benchmark of Learned and Classical Methods
summary: Recent learned fault-tolerant-control (FTC) work reports high success on spacecraft actuator faults, but often in simulation, on narrow fault sets, and with transient metrics that a trajectory need only touch once. We ask what recovers spacecraft pointing when success means holding it on faults never seen in training. We answer with a benchmark built around a settled gate, pointing held within 0.2 deg over a dwell window and scored on the true state, train/test splits disjoint in inertia, gain, sign pattern, and bias, Wilson intervals over n=500 episodes per cell, and one-command reproduction on a 6-DOF Basilisk testbed. Across classical, adaptive, learned end-to-end, and structured controllers, three findings stand out. Fault-unaware PD/PID and from-scratch end-to-end RL score 0%, so learning capacity alone is not the lever. Classical adaptive laws resolve sign faults but handle gain poorly at 55.2%, and a literature-faithful Nussbaum-gain law reaches 45.2% and 3.2%. A structured estimate-then-control design, with a learned recurrent module that infers actuator gain online and feeds an analytic law, wins on sign and gain faults at 97.8% and 94.4%, approaching the privileged oracle while unstructured methods remain at zero. The hard wall is constant additive bias, which is 0% for every controller including the privileged gain oracle, because an integral-free law cannot null a constant disturbance. We close it with a disturbance observer that recovers bias from the dynamics and is self-correcting for gain-estimate error. Composed with the gain estimate, it recovers 59.4% of held-out bias faults with no sign/gain regression, moving that class off zero. We classify sensor-fault regimes similarly, show that sensor bias is unobservable from the corrupted measurement alone and therefore requires fusion rather than an observer, and release the benchmark so the gate is shared.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个航天器故障容错控制基准测试，发现无故障感知的控制器成功率为0%，结构化"估计-控制"方法在增益和符号故障上达到94%以上，但恒定偏差对包括理想化控制器在内的所有方法都是难题，最终通过扰动观测器恢复59.4%的偏差故障。
AI.motivation: 现有学习型故障容错控制(FTC)方法通常在仿真中、在狭窄故障集上、用只需触及一次的瞬态指标评估，成功率看似很高，但无法保证在未见过的故障上实现持续指向保持。本文旨在构建一个更严格的基准测试，评估不同控制器在真实航天器指向保持任务上的表现。
AI.method: 构建了一个以稳定门控为核心的基准测试：指向精度保持在0.2度内、持续观察窗口、基于真实状态评分、训练/测试按惯性、增益、符号模式、偏差划分、每个单元500回合的Wilson区间，并在6-DOF Basilisk测试台上可单命令复现。比较了经典、自适应、学习端到端和结构化控制器。
AI.result: 1) 无故障感知PD/PID和从零学习端到端RL得分0%；2) 经典自适应律处理符号故障良好但增益故障仅55.2%，Nussbaum增益律达45.2%和3.2%；3) 结构化估计-控制设计（学习型循环模块推断执行器增益+解析控制律）在符号和增益故障上达97.8%和94.4%；4) 恒定加性偏差对所有控制器（包括理想化增益oracle）均为0%；5) 加入扰动观测器恢复59.4%的偏差故障且不退化符号/增益性能。
AI.conclusion: 结构化设计优于纯学习方法，恒定偏差是核心难题需扰动观测器解决，传感器偏差需融合而非观测器，并开源了基准测试。
idea_en: A structured estimate-then-control design for spacecraft actuator fault recovery, featuring a learned recurrent module that infers actuator gain online and feeds into an analytic control law, achieving high performance on sign and gain faults unseen in training.

A disturbance observer for spacecraft attitude control that recovers constant additive bias from dynamics and is self-correcting for gain-estimate error, composed with a gain estimator to handle bias faults without regressing sign/gain performance.

A benchmark methodology for evaluating fault-tolerant spacecraft control that uses settled gate criteria, pointing held within 0.2 degrees over a dwell window, train/test splits disjoint in inertia, gain, sign pattern, and bias, Wilson intervals over n=500 episodes per cell, and one-command reproduction on a 6-DOF Basilisk testbed.

A classification framework for sensor-fault regimes in spacecraft, demonstrating that sensor bias is unobservable from the corrupted measurement alone and therefore requires sensor fusion rather than an observer-based approach.
idea_ch: 一种结构化"估计-控制"航天器执行器故障恢复设计，包含学习型循环模块在线推断执行器增益并输入解析控制律，对训练中未见过的符号和增益故障实现高性能。
一种用于航天器姿态控制的扰动观测器，从动力学中恢复恒定加性偏差并对增益估计误差具有自校正能力，与增益估计器组合处理偏差故障而不退化符号/增益性能。
一种评估故障容错航天器控制的基准测试方法，使用稳定门控准则、0.2度指向精度保持窗口、按惯性/增益/符号模式/偏差划分的训练/测试集、每单元500回合的Wilson区间，以及6-DOF Basilisk测试台的单命令复现能力。
一种航天器传感器故障分类框架，证明传感器偏差仅从被污染测量值中不可观测，因此需要传感器融合而非基于观测器的方法。

title: Offline Multi-agent Continual Cooperation via Skill Partition and Reuse
summary: Extracting skills from multi-agent offline dataset improves learning efficiency via sharing task-invariant coordination skills among tasks. In settings where tasks occur sequentially and the space of skills grows exponentially, existing approaches that rely on heuristically designed and fixed-sized skill libraries struggle to resolve the problem of distributional shift and interference, facing catastrophic forgetting and plasticity loss. To address this problem and endow agents with the ability to continually discover and reuse coordination skills in open-environment, we propose COMAD, a principled framework for Continual Offline Multi-agent Skill Discovery via Skill Partition and Reuse. We first discover skills from mixed multi-agent behavior data with an auto-encoder to transform coordination knowledge into reusable coordination skills. Then we construct a skill-augmented policy learning objective with multi-head architectures, explicitly guiding the advantage function with reusable skills identified via a density-based reusability estimator. Theoretical analysis shows our method approximates the optimum of a continual skill discovery problem. Empirical results across diverse MARL benchmarks show that COMAD continually expands its skill library to mitigate interference, achieving superior forward and backward transfer for task streams compared to multiple baselines.

AI.tldr: COMAD提出了一种面向多智能体连续离线场景的技能发现框架，通过技能划分与复用不断扩展技能库，缓解分布偏移与干扰问题，实现前向与后向迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在任务序列中出现且技能空间指数增长时，依赖启发式设计的固定大小技能库，无法解决分布偏移和干扰问题，面临灾难性遗忘和可塑性丧失。
AI.method: 1) 使用自编码器从混合多智能体行为数据中提取可复用的协调技能；2) 构建带有多头架构的技能增强策略学习目标；3) 通过基于密度的可复用性估计器识别可复用技能，指导优势函数。
AI.result: 在多个MARL基准测试中，COMAD能持续扩展技能库以缓解干扰，在任务流上实现优于多个基线的正向和反向迁移。
AI.conclusion: COMAD框架通过技能划分与复用有效解决了连续离线多智能体场景下的灾难性遗忘和分布偏移问题，理论分析证明该方法逼近连续技能发现问题的最优解。
idea_en: A method for continual offline multi-agent skill discovery using auto-encoder to extract reusable coordination skills from mixed behavior data.
A skill-augmented policy learning framework with multi-head architectures that guides advantage function using density-based reusability estimator.
A dynamic skill library expansion mechanism that mitigates distributional shift and interference in sequential task streams.
A density-based reusability estimator that identifies which previously discovered skills are applicable to new tasks.
idea_ch: 一种基于自编码器的连续离线多智能体技能发现方法，从混合行为数据中提取可复用的协调技能
一种带有多头架构的技能增强策略学习框架，通过基于密度的可复用性估计器指导优势函数
一种动态技能库扩展机制，在序列任务流中缓解分布偏移和干扰问题
一种基于密度的可复用性估计器，用于识别先前发现的技能是否适用于新任务

title: Long-Term Simulation Exposes Cognitive-Developmental Risks in AI Companions
summary: AI companions powered by large language models increasingly interact with cognition-developing users, including children and adolescents, creating risks that may accumulate over time. Existing safety evaluations largely rely on single-turn or short-session tests, which cannot capture risks that emerge only through prolonged interaction. To address this gap, we propose TSJ (Theater-Stage-Judge), a longitudinal framework combining persona-driven user simulation, dynamic psychological-state updating and retrospective evaluation. We evaluate six mainstream models across four developmental stages, twenty-four risk dimensions and three psychological-vulnerability personas, covering 12,960 simulated person-day interactions. TSJ shows that short-horizon testing systematically underestimates developmental risks, for which TSJ yields a stable risk estimate only after 140 turns within prolonged simulated relationships. Applying TSJ further identifies early childhood and emerging adulthood as the most vulnerable stages, with cognitive trust and emotional dependency as the weakest domains. TSJ provides a scalable methodology for longitudinal cognitive developmental risk evaluation in AI companion systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TSJ（Theater-Stage-Judge）纵向评估框架，通过角色驱动的用户模拟、动态心理状态更新和回溯性评估，发现AI伴侣系统在长期交互中会对认知发展中的用户（如儿童和青少年）产生累积风险，而短期测试会系统性低估这些风险。
AI.motivation: 现有AI伴侣安全评估主要依赖单轮或短会话测试，无法捕捉仅在长期交互中才显现的累积风险，尤其对认知发展中的用户（儿童和青少年）存在安全隐患。
AI.method: 提出TSJ框架，包含三部分：1）角色驱动的用户模拟（persona-driven user simulation）；2）动态心理状态更新（dynamic psychological-state updating）；3）回溯性评估（retrospective evaluation）。在12,960个模拟人-日交互中评估6个主流模型，覆盖4个发展阶段、24个风险维度和3种心理脆弱性角色。
AI.result: 短期测试系统性低估了发展风险，TSJ在模拟长期关系的约140轮交互后获得稳定风险估计；早期儿童和新兴成年期是最脆弱阶段；认知信任和情感依赖是最薄弱的风险域。
AI.conclusion: TSJ提供了一种可扩展的方法论，用于AI伴侣系统中纵向认知发展风险评估，揭示了长期交互中累积风险的重要性。
idea_en: A longitudinal risk evaluation framework (Theater-Stage-Judge) for AI companion systems that uses persona-driven user simulation to model cognitive-developmental users across different developmental stages, enabling detection of risks that only emerge through prolonged interaction.

A dynamic psychological-state updating mechanism that simulates how a user's cognitive and emotional state evolves over extended interactions with an AI companion, allowing real-time risk tracking across multi-turn conversations.

A retrospective evaluation methodology for AI safety that analyzes accumulated interaction logs after prolonged simulated relationships (≥140 turns) to produce stable risk estimates, overcoming the limitations of single-turn or short-session testing.

A multi-dimensional risk assessment system covering 24 risk dimensions across 4 developmental stages (early childhood, adolescence, emerging adulthood, adulthood) with 3 psychological-vulnerability personas for comprehensive AI companion safety profiling.
idea_ch: 一种用于AI伴侣系统的纵向风险评估框架（Theater-Stage-Judge），通过角色驱动的用户模拟来建模不同发展阶段的认知发展用户，能够检测仅在长期交互中才显现的风险。
一种动态心理状态更新机制，模拟用户在与AI伴侣的长时间交互过程中认知和情感状态的演变，实现跨多轮对话的实时风险追踪。
一种AI安全回溯性评估方法，在模拟长期关系（≥140轮）后分析累积交互日志以产生稳定的风险估计，克服了单轮或短会话测试的局限性。
一种覆盖4个发展阶段（早期儿童、青少年、新兴成年期、成年期）、24个风险维度和3种心理脆弱性角色的多维风险评估系统，用于全面的AI伴侣安全性能画像。

title: BrainAgent: A Large Language Model-Driven Multi-Agent Framework for Autonomous Brain Signal Understanding
summary: Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs) and brain signal understanding are pivotal for clinical health and next-generation interactions. Despite this significance, its widespread adoption in real-world scenarios remains restricted, primarily because current analytical paradigms lack sufficient agentic intelligence. First, existing methodologies impose prohibitive technical barriers, requiring extensive specialized expertise. Second, they remain inherently static and task-specific, failing to execute the complex, long-horizon workflows essential for real-world deployment. To accelerate the democratization of brain signal understanding, we draw inspiration from Large Language Models (LLMs) to introduce BrainAgent, an LLM-driven multi-agent framework designed to ground abstract natural language intent into rigorous, executable, and end-to-end processing pipelines. BrainAgent employs a hierarchical architecture where a central supervisor orchestrates specialized sub-agents for adaptive task decomposition and execution. Furthermore, we establish a comprehensive, systematic benchmark for evaluating agentic systems in brain signal analysis. Empirical results demonstrate that BrainAgent effectively automates complex workflows with superior reliability, marking a paradigm shift toward democratized brain signal understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BrainAgent——一种由大语言模型驱动的多智能体框架，通过层级架构将自然语言意图转化为可执行的脑信号分析流程，旨在降低脑机接口的技术门槛并实现复杂工作流的自动化。
AI.motivation: 当前脑信号分析方法存在两大瓶颈：1) 技术门槛高，需要大量专业知识；2) 方法静态且任务特定，无法处理真实场景中复杂的长期工作流。亟需一种智能化的脑信号理解框架来推动该领域的普及。
AI.method: BrainAgent采用层级式多智能体架构：中心监督者（Supervisor）负责任务分解与协调，多个专门化子智能体（Sub-agents）分别执行信号预处理、特征提取、模式分类等具体任务。利用大语言模型将抽象的自然语言意图转化为可执行的端到端处理流水线，并建立了一套系统化的评估基准。
AI.result: 实验结果表明BrainAgent能够以更高的可靠性自动化复杂脑信号分析工作流，实现了向脑信号理解民主化的范式转变。
AI.conclusion: BrainAgent证明了LLM驱动的多智能体系统在脑信号分析领域具有显著潜力，为降低脑机接口应用门槛、推动真实世界部署提供了可行的技术路径。
idea_en: An LLM-driven multi-agent hierarchical framework for brain signal analysis that translates natural language intent into executable processing pipelines through a central supervisor orchestrating specialized sub-agents.
A dynamic task decomposition and execution method for brain-computer interfaces that adaptively breaks down complex long-horizon workflows into sub-tasks handled by specialized agent modules.
A comprehensive benchmarking system specifically designed for evaluating agentic AI systems in brain signal understanding and analysis tasks.
idea_ch: 一种基于大语言模型驱动的层级式多智能体脑信号分析框架，通过中心监督者协调专门化子智能体，将自然语言意图转化为可执行的端到端处理流水线
一种用于脑机接口的动态任务分解与执行方法，能够自适应地将复杂的长期工作流拆解为由专门化智能体模块处理的子任务

title: Quantization Inflates Reasoning: Token Inflation as a Hidden Cost of Low-Bit Reasoning Models
summary: Quantization is widely used to reduce the inference cost of large language models, but its effect on reasoning models is not fully captured by final-answer accuracy or per-token latency. We show that low-bit post-training quantization can introduce a hidden test-time compute cost: quantized reasoning models often generate longer chains of thought even when they still answer correctly. Across mathematical reasoning, code generation, scientific question answering, and agentic tool-use benchmarks, we find that INT4/INT3 quantization can preserve accuracy but increase reasoning-token usage, offsetting the expected per-token speedup. To measure this effect, we introduce the CoT Token Inflation Ratio, which compares reasoning length between quantized and full-precision models averaged across all evaluation benchmarks. We further show that token inflation is accompanied by behavioral changes in the reasoning trace, including more intermediate steps and greater semantic repetition. These changes translate into measurable end-to-end real-world serving penalties. Finally, we evaluate mitigation strategies and find that prompting and decoding-time sampling offer inconsistent accuracy-length trade-offs, while quantization-aware training shows more promise in reducing both accuracy degradation and token inflation. Our results suggest that reasoning-token usage should be reported alongside accuracy when evaluating quantized reasoning models.

AI.tldr: 研究表明低比特后训练量化虽能保持推理模型准确性，但会导致推理链变长（CoT Token膨胀），抵消预期的每token加速收益，甚至带来额外推理成本。
AI.motivation: 量化技术广泛用于降低大模型推理成本，但现有评估仅关注最终准确率或每token延迟，忽略了量化对推理模型推理长度的影响，可能导致量化被高估。
AI.method: 在数学推理、代码生成、科学问答和智能体工具使用等多个基准上，对比INT4/INT3量化模型与全精度模型的推理长度变化。引入CoT Token膨胀比（Inflation Ratio）作为量化评估指标，分析推理轨迹行为变化（中间步骤增多、语义重复），并评估多种缓解策略（提示工程、解码采样、量化感知训练）。
AI.result: INT4/INT3量化在保持准确率的同时，显著增加了推理token使用量；CoT Token膨胀比可量化此效应；膨胀伴随更多中间步骤和语义重复，导致实际服务延迟惩罚；提示工程和解码采样无法兼顾准确率与长度，量化感知训练在降低准确率退化和token膨胀方面更有前景。
AI.conclusion: 评估量化推理模型时，应将推理token使用量作为关键指标与准确率一同报告，否则量化带来的真实成本会被低估。
idea_en: A method for evaluating quantized reasoning models by measuring CoT Token Inflation Ratio (CTIR) alongside accuracy, providing a comprehensive assessment metric that captures hidden inference cost.
A post-training quantization optimization technique that jointly minimizes accuracy degradation and CoT token inflation through quantization-aware training with token-length regularization.
A decoding-time sampling strategy with length-aware penalty to reduce token inflation in quantized reasoning models while preserving accuracy.
A system and method for detecting behavioral changes in reasoning traces (intermediate steps count, semantic repetition rate) as indicators of quantization-induced token inflation.
idea_ch: 一种通过测量CoT Token膨胀比（CTIR）与准确率相结合来评估量化推理模型的方法，提供能够捕获隐藏推理成本的综合评估指标。
一种联合最小化准确率退化和CoT Token膨胀的后训练量化优化技术，通过带有token长度正则化的量化感知训练实现。
一种带有长度感知惩罚的解码采样策略，用于在保持准确率的同时减少量化推理模型中的token膨胀。
一种通过检测推理轨迹行为变化（中间步骤数量、语义重复率）作为量化诱导token膨胀指标的系统和方法。

title: Cliff Tokens: Identifying Single-Token Failure Triggers in LLM Mathematical Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) reach high accuracy in mathematical reasoning, but individual traces on the same problem diverge; some arrive at the correct answer while others fail. Prior work analyzes failure at the step, chunk, or sentence level, or at tokens where failure has already occurred. Neither identifies the precise token that triggers the shift toward failure. We introduce the cliff token, a token where the token-wise potential drops significantly under an adaptive threshold that scales with the local token-wise potential, based on a one-sided two-proportion z-test. Across seven models and three mathematical reasoning benchmarks (GSM1K, MATH500, AIME 2025), cliff tokens act as failure triggers; deleting the first cliff token and resampling recovers pass@64 to 1.0, while keeping it limits recovery to between 0.71 and 1.00. We further introduce a cliff taxonomy of deterministic, uncertain, and sampled-off cliffs, defined by greedy choice and token entropy. Each type has distinct probabilistic characteristics, and the taxonomy generalizes across model scales. Finally, we validate the taxonomy via single-token preference optimization at cliff positions (Cliff-DPO). Trained on GSM8K, Cliff-DPO improves accuracy across benchmarks by up to +6.6. Optimizing at uncertain and sampled-off cliffs improves reasoning, while deterministic cliffs do not.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"悬崖词元"概念，即导致大语言模型数学推理失败的关键词元，通过自适应阈值和单侧比例z检验识别。删除悬崖词元可恢复推理至pass@64=1.0，并基于贪心选择和词元熵建立分类体系（确定型、不确定型、采样偏移型），通过Cliff-DPO在悬崖位置进行偏好优化，最高提升6.6%准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有工作仅在步骤、句子或已发生失败的词元层面分析LLM数学推理失败，未能精确定位触发失败转向的起始词元。
AI.method: 提出"悬崖词元"概念，基于单侧双比例z检验和自适应阈值（与局部词元潜力成比例缩放）识别词元潜力显著下降的位置。进一步依据贪心选择一致性（greedy choice）和词元熵（token entropy）将悬崖词元分为三类：确定型(Deterministic)、不确定型(Uncertain)和采样偏移型(Sampled-off)。在识别出的悬崖位置进行单次词元偏好优化(Cliff-DPO)。
AI.result: 跨7个模型和3个数学推理基准（GSM1K、MATH500、AIME 2025）验证：删除首个悬崖词元并重新采样可将pass@64恢复至1.0；Cliff-DPO在多个基准上最高提升+6.6准确率；分类体系跨模型规模泛化。
AI.conclusion: 悬崖词元是LLM推理失败的关键触发点；不同类型的悬崖词元具有显著不同的概率特性；在不确定型和采样偏移型悬崖位置优化可有效提升推理能力，而确定型悬崖则无此效果。
idea_en: A method for identifying failure-triggering 'cliff tokens' in LLM reasoning chains using a one-sided two-proportion z-test with an adaptive threshold scaled to local token-wise potential, enabling precise localization of the exact token where reasoning begins to diverge toward failure.

A cliff token taxonomy system classifying failure-triggering tokens into three types (Deterministic, Uncertain, Sampled-off) based on greedy choice consistency and token entropy, providing a framework for understanding distinct probabilistic characteristics of different failure modes.

A single-token preference optimization method (Cliff-DPO) that performs targeted optimization specifically at cliff token positions in reasoning chains, improving mathematical reasoning accuracy by up to +6.6% across multiple benchmarks.

An adaptive threshold mechanism for detecting significant drops in token-wise potential, where the threshold scales proportionally with local token-wise potential rather than using a fixed global threshold, improving detection accuracy across varying contexts.

A method for recovering reasoning chain accuracy by deleting the first identified cliff token and resampling subsequent tokens, achieving pass@64 recovery to 1.0 across multiple models and mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
idea_ch: 一种基于单侧双比例z检验和自适应阈值（与局部词元潜力成比例缩放）的悬崖词元识别方法，精确定位LLM推理链中触发失败转向的关键词元位置

title: Agentic evolution of physically constrained foundation models
comment: 29 pages, 5 main figures and 4 extended data figures
summary: Artificial intelligence increasingly drives automated scientific discovery, yet contemporary generalist agents lack physical grounding, frequently hallucinating hardware-incompatible designs. Here, we present a physically grounded, multi-agent discovery engine that autonomously architects hardware-compliant computing systems. Anchored by an Evolutionary Knowledge Graph structuring past scientific innovations, the framework extracts an "algorithmic Chain-of-Thought" to transform blind stochastic search into directed structural evolution. Applied to the extreme testbed of foundation model deployment, the engine evolved two hardware-aware compression methodologies surpassing human-engineered heuristics: Q-Enhance mitigates long-context accuracy loss in dense models, and MoE-Salient-AQ outperforms state-of-the-art manual sparse Mixture-of-Experts designs by 3.7% at sub-3-bit regimes. Utilizing a bandwidth-efficient Sensitivity Profile, we successfully deployed a massive 235-billion-parameter model onto a constrained dual-A100 server, reducing memory requirements by 75% with a marginal 0.64% accuracy degradation. By transforming unconstrained combinatorial search into knowledge-driven autonomy, this establishes a scalable hardware-software co-design paradigm for machine-driven discovery within strict physical boundaries.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种物理约束下的多智能体发现引擎，通过进化知识图谱和算法思维链，自动设计硬件兼容的计算系统，并在大模型部署中实现了超越人工设计的压缩方法。
AI.motivation: 现有通用智能体缺乏物理约束，常产生与硬件不兼容的设计，需要一种能够自动发现硬件兼容方案的框架。
AI.method: 基于进化知识图谱(Evolutionary Knowledge Graph)结构化存储历史科学创新，提取"算法思维链"(algorithmic Chain-of-Thought)，将盲随机搜索转化为有向结构进化。采用多智能体架构，通过带宽高效的敏感度配置文件(Sensitivity Profile)实现硬件感知的模型压缩。
AI.result: 演化出两种超越人工的硬件感知压缩方法：Q-Enhance缓解长上下文精度损失；MoE-Salient-AQ在sub-3-bit场景下比手动设计提升3.7%。成功将2350亿参数模型部署到受限双A100服务器，内存减少75%，精度仅下降0.64%。
AI.conclusion: 将无约束的组合搜索转化为知识驱动的自主发现，建立了在严格物理边界内可扩展的硬件-软件协同设计范式。
idea_en: Physically-grounded multi-agent discovery engine that autonomously architects hardware-compliant computing systems using an Evolutionary Knowledge Graph
Algorithmic Chain-of-Thought extraction method that transforms blind stochastic search into directed structural evolution for hardware design
Q-Enhance compression methodology for mitigating long-context accuracy loss in dense models

title: Reasonable Motion: A General ASP Foundation for Environment Constrained Movement Trajectory Computation
comment: Accepted at: LPNMR 2026 - 18th International Conference on Logic Programming and Non-monotonic Reasoning, 7 - 11 September 2026 - Klagenfurt, Austria
summary: We present a general answer set programming based hybrid quantitative-qualitative method for computing constrained branching trajectory modes for moving objects in real-world settings. The method performs constrained traversal of an environment graph, enumerating geometrically admissible motion behaviours as stable models, each constituting a distinct trajectory mode characterised by both domain-dependent and independent factors such as derived event sequence, map topology, and domain norms. The hybrid trajectory computation method is generally applicable across motion characteristics typically encountered in diverse dynamic domains with moving objects, e.g., autonomous driving. We demonstrate applicability and highlight how computed trajectories are traceable to their underlying stable model, thereby affording verifiable interpretability that purely learned approaches cannot provide. We also perform an empirical evaluation with Argoverse 2, a large-scale real-world autonomous driving benchmark representative of the class of dynamic domains within the scope of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于回答集编程的混合定量-定性方法，用于计算现实环境中移动物体的约束分支轨迹模式，通过环境图的约束遍历生成可解释的几何可行运动行为。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在计算移动物体轨迹时，难以同时处理定量(几何约束)和定性(事件序列、拓扑、领域规范)因素，且纯学习方法缺乏可验证的可解释性。需要一种既能处理混合约束又能提供可追溯解释的轨迹计算方法。
AI.method: 基于回答集编程(Answer Set Programming, ASP)的混合定量-定性方法：对环境图进行约束遍历，将几何可行的运动行为枚举为稳定模型(stable models)。每个稳定模型构成一个独特的轨迹模式，同时考虑领域相关因素(如导出事件序列)和领域无关因素(如图拓扑、领域规范)。
AI.result: 在Argoverse 2真实世界自动驾驶数据集上进行了实证评估，验证了方法的适用性。计算的轨迹可追溯到其底层的稳定模型，提供了纯学习方法无法提供的可验证可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法适用于具有移动物体的各类动态领域(如自动驾驶)，通过ASP的稳定模型语义实现了轨迹的可追溯性和可解释性，为混合定量-定性轨迹计算提供了通用框架。
idea_en: Answer Set Programming (ASP) based hybrid quantitative-qualitative trajectory computation method that generates constraint-satisfying branching trajectory modes by enumerating stable models from environment graph traversal.
Stable model-based trajectory traceability and verifiable interpretability system that links each computed trajectory to its underlying stable model for explainable motion behavior analysis.

Domain-agnostic constrained environment graph traversal framework that simultaneously handles quantitative geometric constraints and qualitative factors (event sequences, map topology, domain norms) for moving object trajectory generation.
Hybrid trajectory mode enumeration method that characterizes distinct motion behaviors using both domain-dependent and domain-independent factors derived from answer set programming stable models.
idea_ch: 基于回答集编程(ASP)的混合定量-定性轨迹计算方法：通过对环境图进行约束遍历，将几何可行的运动行为枚举为稳定模型，生成满足约束的分支轨迹模式。
基于稳定模型的轨迹可追溯与可验证可解释性系统：将每条计算轨迹链接到其底层稳定模型，为运动行为分析提供可验证的解释能力。
领域无关的约束环境图遍历框架：同时处理定量几何约束和定性因素(事件序列、地图拓扑、领域规范)，用于移动物体轨迹生成。
