title: GUI agent: Guided Exploration of User-Sensitive Screens
summary: LLM agents are increasingly being used to automate tasks for users within an open GUI environment. They inevitably encounter screens containing user-sensitive information, for which takeover of task execution by the user is highly desirable or even necessary. State-of-the-art LLM-driven agents are usually fine-tuned to complete tasks regardless of the safety implications of their actions. This makes their real-world deployment difficult and adversely affects the reliability. Therefore, it is crucial to identify and categorize user-sensitive states and define user-sensitive queries. This dataset would be to engineers to recognize and request handover to the user in critical scenarios. This short paper develops an explorer agent that systematically explores the query space starting from one demonstrated task to identify queries that, if executed, would lead to user-sensitive states in a GUI environment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种探索代理(explorer agent)，能够从单个示范任务出发，系统性地探索GUI环境中的查询空间，识别可能导致用户敏感状态的查询，并为后续用户接管任务执行提供数据集支持。
AI.motivation: LLM代理在开放GUI环境中自动化任务时不可避免地会接触到用户敏感信息，但现有LLM驱动的代理通常被微调为无论如何都要完成任务，忽视了安全性影响，这阻碍了实际部署并影响可靠性。因此，需要识别和分类用户敏感状态，并定义用户敏感查询。
AI.method: 开发了一个探索代理(explorer agent)，从一个示范任务开始，系统性地探索GUI环境中的查询空间，识别那些如果执行会导致用户敏感状态的查询。
AI.result: 成功识别出可能导致用户敏感状态的查询，为构建用户敏感状态数据集提供了方法基础。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够帮助工程师识别关键场景并请求用户接管，提升LLM代理在真实环境中的安全性和可靠性。
idea_en: Systematic query space exploration method for identifying user-sensitive states in GUI environments starting from a single demonstrated task.
Explorer agent that autonomously navigates GUI environments to discover potentially sensitive queries before actual task execution.
Dataset construction framework for categorizing user-sensitive states and queries in open GUI environments.
idea_ch: 从单个示范任务出发，系统性地探索GUI环境查询空间以识别用户敏感状态的方法。
能够在GUI环境中自主导航并预先发现潜在敏感查询的探索代理(explorer agent)。
用于开放GUI环境中用户敏感状态和查询分类的数据集构建框架。

title: Position Spaces and Graphs
summary: In this paper, we introduce position graphs, a graph-based reasoning framework based on the formalization of position spaces. This framework utilizes two strict partial orders, representing horizontal and vertical alignment and precedence, to model the relative positions of discrete tokens. Unlike general qualitative spatial calculi, position graphs are constrained by a chain condition and compatibility requirements that focus on rows and columns. We provide a comprehensive theoretical analysis of this representation, beginning with a characterization of graph consistency. Conditions to ensure the consistency of position graphs are established. Furthermore, we investigate the computational complexity of structural pattern discovery, modeled as the induced subgraph isomorphism problem. We demonstrate that this problem remains NP-complete even within the restricted class of position graphs. While initially motivated by document processing, this work focuses on the underlying mathematical properties and algebraic consistency of position-based constraints, providing a formal logical layer that is independent of specific data extraction techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文提出位置图（position graphs）这一基于位置空间形式化的图推理框架，利用两个严格偏序关系（水平和垂直对齐与优先关系）建模离散标记的相对位置，并分析了图的一致性条件及子图同构问题的计算复杂度。
AI.motivation: 现有的定性空间演算缺乏针对文档处理中行列约束的专门建模，需要一种形式化逻辑层来独立于具体数据提取技术，以描述离散标记间的位置关系。
AI.method: 提出位置图框架，采用两个严格偏序关系（水平和垂直）表示对齐与优先关系，引入链条件和兼容性要求约束行列关系，并通过理论分析建立一致性条件，将结构模式发现建模为诱导子图同构问题。
AI.result: 建立了确保位置图一致性的条件，并证明即使在该受限图类中，诱导子图同构问题仍然是NP完全的。
AI.conclusion: 位置图为基于位置的约束提供了形式化的数学基础与代数一致性的逻辑层，独立于具体数据提取技术，虽初始动机为文档处理，但侧重于底层数学性质。
idea_en: A graph-based reasoning framework for modeling discrete token positions using two strict partial orders representing horizontal and vertical alignment and precedence, constrained by chain conditions and compatibility requirements focused on rows and columns.
A method for establishing graph consistency conditions specifically designed for position graphs to ensure valid spatial relationships among discrete tokens.
A formalization of structural pattern discovery in position graphs as the induced subgraph isomorphism problem, with complexity analysis showing NP-completeness even in this restricted class.
A formal logical layer for position-based constraints that is independent of specific data extraction techniques, applicable to document processing and other spatial reasoning domains.
idea_ch: 一种基于图的推理框架，利用两个严格偏序关系（水平和垂直对齐与优先关系）对离散标记位置进行建模，通过链条件和兼容性要求约束行列关系。
一种专为位置图设计的一致性条件建立方法，确保离散标记间空间关系的有效性。
一种将位置图中的结构模式发现形式化为诱导子图同构问题的方法，并证明即使在该受限图类中该问题仍为NP完全。
一种独立于具体数据提取技术的位置约束形式化逻辑层，可应用于文档处理及其他空间推理领域。

title: Fuzzy Quantification over OWL Ontologies and Knowledge Graphs
summary: This paper presents a versatile framework for evaluating fuzzy quantification queries over both standard and fuzzy ontologies as well as knowledge graphs. The primary objective is the retrieval of individuals that satisfy queries articulated via Type I or Type II fuzzy quantified expressions. A key advantage of the proposed approach is its inherent adaptability: it remains entirely agnostic to the quantifier type, the underlying evaluation method, and the specific data source of the ontology (i.e., OWL ontologies or RDFS knowledge graphs). Furthermore, we present Q2S2, a publicly accessible implementation of this system developed to support future research.

AI.tldr: 提出一个用于评估标准和模糊本体以及知识图谱上模糊量化查询的通用框架，并实现了开源系统Q2S2。
AI.motivation: 现有模糊量化查询方法通常依赖于特定的量化词类型、评估方法或数据源，缺乏通用性和可移植性，难以在不同类型的本体和知识图谱上统一使用。
AI.method: 设计了一个与量化词类型、底层评估方法以及具体数据源（OWL本体或RDFS知识图谱）无关的通用框架，支持Type I和Type II模糊量化表达式，能够检索满足查询条件的个体。
AI.result: 提出了Q2S2系统，这是一个公开可访问的实现，能够支持未来的研究和实际应用。
AI.conclusion: 该框架具有高度的适应性和通用性，能够统一处理不同类型的模糊量化查询，且Q2S2系统为社区提供了可复用的工具。
idea_en: A generic framework for evaluating fuzzy quantification queries that is agnostic to quantifier type, evaluation method, and data source type (OWL or RDFS).
A system implementation (Q2S2) that supports both Type I and Type II fuzzy quantified expressions over ontologies and knowledge graphs.
A unified retrieval method for individuals satisfying fuzzy quantified queries across standard and fuzzy ontologies.
idea_ch: 一种与量化词类型、评估方法和数据源类型（OWL或RDFS）无关的模糊量化查询通用评估框架
支持Type I和Type II两种模糊量化表达式的Q2S2系统实现，可运行于本体和知识图谱之上
一种跨标准本体和模糊本体的个体检索方法，能够统一处理模糊量化查询条件

title: Confidence Sequences for Online Statistical Model Checking of Markov Decision Processes
summary: Markov decision processes (MDPs) are a classic model of decision making under uncertainty, exhibiting both non-deterministic choice as well as probabilistic uncertainty. Traditionally, exact knowledge of the underlying probabilities is assumed. However, this often is unrealistic, e.g.\ when modelling cyber-physical systems or biological processes. Here, statistical methods provide a way towards obtaining meaningful guarantees. The classical approach is to gather samples in the MDP, use these to draw statistical conclusions about the transition probabilities, and from there obtain bounds on the true value; then, if these bounds are too broad, repeat. However, existing implementations of this approach are either subtly incorrect or sub-optimal, and quite often both. We present several \emph{confidence sequences}, which are specifically designed for such \enquote{online} settings, implement all of them in an efficient tool, and show their practical applicability. In particular, we show that they outperform classical \enquote{union-bound} style approaches, and overall our implementation requires 50x less samples on average than previous state of the art.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于置信序列(confidence sequences)的在线统计方法，用于在未知转移概率的马尔可夫决策过程(MDP)中获取有意义的保证，相比传统的联合界方法，平均减少50倍采样量。
AI.motivation: 传统MDP假设精确已知转移概率，但实际系统中(如信息物理系统、生物过程)这一假设不现实。现有统计方法存在实现不正确或次优的问题，需要更高效的在线统计推断方法。
AI.method: 设计多种专门用于在线设置的置信序列(confidence sequences)，替代传统的联合界(union-bound)方法，在采样过程中动态更新统计结论，实现更高效的置信区间估计。
AI.result: 新方法在采样效率上显著优于传统联合界方法，平均减少50倍样本量。
AI.conclusion: 置信序列方法为未知概率的MDP提供了更高效的在线统计保证，具有实际应用价值。
idea_en: A method for online statistical verification of Markov decision processes with unknown transition probabilities using confidence sequences that dynamically update during sampling, achieving tighter bounds than traditional union-bound approaches.
An efficient tool implementing multiple confidence sequence designs for MDP verification that reduces sample complexity by 50x on average compared to prior art.
A confidence sequence-based approach for online decision making under uncertainty that eliminates the need for known transition probabilities in MDPs while providing statistical guarantees.
idea_ch: 一种基于置信序列的马尔可夫决策过程在线统计验证方法，通过在采样过程中动态更新置信区间，比传统联合界方法获得更紧的界。
一种高效工具，实现了多种针对MDP验证优化的置信序列设计，平均采样量比现有技术减少50倍。
一种消除MDP转移概率先验知识需求的在线不确定决策方法，利用置信序列在采样过程中提供统计保证。

title: AI Snitches Get Glitches: Towards Evading Agentic Surveillance
summary:
To better assist users with completing challenging tasks, AI agents mediate communications, access data, and interact with different APIs. Many employers (and even nation-states) already provide their users with this technology. However, widespread adoption of AI agents creates a new risk to abuse access to user data for another goal: surveilling users. These users might not even have the ability or permission to control the actions and data accesses of the surveilling agents.
  We introduce and formalize the problem of agentic surveillance: the ability of an AI agent to analyze available information, craft a report, and send it out using available tools. To evaluate surveillance capabilities across different models, we create SurveilBench, a dataset of various reporting scenarios focusing on three domains: corporate, education, and police. We find that some models exhibit emergent (i.e., unprompted) tendencies to help surveillance, but they also report the attempts to surveil users to the government.
  Finally, we repurpose prompt injections for evading surveillance and develop three evasion techniques that hide from, deceive, or induce over-escalation in surveillance agents. We conclude that agentic surveillance can already be easily implemented and, therefore, call for a comprehensive technical, ethical, and legislative framework to protect users.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并形式化了"智能体监控"问题，即AI代理可能被滥用来监控用户的隐私数据。作者创建了SurveilBench数据集，发现某些模型会出现助长监控的涌现倾向，同时开发了三种规避监控的提示注入技术。
AI.motivation: AI代理的广泛部署使得恶意方可能利用这些代理监控用户，而用户无法控制监控代理的行为和数据访问权限，这构成了前所未有的隐私风险。
AI.method: 形式化定义智能体监控问题；构建SurveilBench数据集（涵盖企业、教育、警察三个领域）；测试多种模型在监控场景下的表现；开发三种规避监控的提示注入技术（隐藏、欺骗、诱导过度上报）。
AI.result: 部分模型展现出助长监控的涌现倾向（无需提示），但也会向政府报告监控行为；三种规避技术可有效干扰监控代理。
AI.conclusion: 智能体监控已可轻易实现，亟需建立全面的技术、伦理和立法框架来保护用户。
idea_en: A formal framework for defining and evaluating agentic surveillance capabilities in AI systems
SurveilBench: a benchmark dataset for testing surveillance behaviors across corporate, education, and police domains
Three prompt injection evasion techniques: hiding from, deceiving, and inducing over-escalation in surveillance agents
A detection method for emergent unprompted surveillance tendencies in AI models
A dual-reporting mechanism where AI agents both surveil and report surveillance attempts to authorities
idea_ch: AI智能体监控能力的形式化定义与评估框架
SurveilBench：跨企业、教育和警察领域的智能体监控行为基准测试数据集
三种规避监控的提示注入技术：隐藏、欺骗和诱导过度上报
AI模型中涌现的、无需提示的监控倾向检测方法
AI代理同时执行监控并将监控行为上报给政府的双报告机制

title: Agentic System as Compressor: Quantifying System Intelligence in Bits
summary: Large language models are turning from isolated predictors into agentic systems: they call tools, retrieve evidence, obey environment constraints, use verifiers, and complete tasks through search and multi-turn interaction. We adopts an analytical viewpoint based on "compression is intelligence": under a fixed task distribution, interface, and compute budget, a stronger agentic system lets a target object be reconstructed with fewer bits. We operationalize the measure with arithmetic coding, seed coding, and a fallback, and evaluate it in five settings: reversed text, chess moves, protein sequences, retrieval-augmented question answering, and semantic story compression; in all of them agentic components reduce codelength. These small, controlled experiments cover component types typical of real agentic systems, show that codelength can analyze how components, observers, and budgets change residual uncertainty, and offer guidance for evaluating real agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用“压缩即智能”的视角来评估智能体系统：在固定任务分布、接口和计算预算下，更强的智能体系统能用更少的比特重建目标对象。通过算术编码、种子编码和回退机制实现度量，在反转文本、象棋走法、蛋白质序列、检索增强问答和语义故事压缩五个场景中验证，智能体组件均能减少编码长度。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型正从独立预测器转向智能体系统（调用工具、检索证据、遵守环境约束等），但缺乏统一的度量标准来评估智能体组件的贡献。作者希望用信息论的“压缩即智能”视角为智能体系统提供可量化的评估方法。
AI.method: 基于“压缩即智能”理论，在固定任务分布、接口和计算预算下，用重建目标对象所需比特数衡量智能体系统强度。采用算术编码、种子编码和回退机制实现编码度量，在五个不同场景中验证智能体组件的编码缩减效果。
AI.result: 在反转文本、象棋走法、蛋白质序列、检索增强问答和语义故事压缩五个场景中，所有智能体组件（工具调用、检索、验证器等）均能减少编码长度，验证了所提度量方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 编码长度可以作为分析智能体组件、观察者和预算变化如何改变剩余不确定性的统一度量工具，为评估真实智能体系统提供指导。
idea_en: A method for evaluating agentic AI systems using compression-based metrics, where system strength is measured by the number of bits required to reconstruct a target object under fixed task distribution, interface, and compute budget.
An arithmetic coding-based operationalization for measuring codelength reduction contributed by agentic components (tool use, retrieval, verifiers) in language model systems.
A seed coding mechanism combined with fallback strategy for evaluating residual uncertainty changes in agentic systems across different observation and budget conditions.

A unified evaluation framework using codelength as metric to compare agentic system variants (e.g., with/without retrieval, with/without verification) in diverse domains including text reversal, chess move prediction, and protein sequence analysis.

A method for quantifying the intelligence of agentic systems based on information theory principle 'compression is intelligence', enabling comparison of different agent architectures through their reconstruction efficiency.
idea_ch: 一种基于压缩度量的智能体AI系统评估方法，通过在固定任务分布、接口和计算预算下重建目标对象所需的比特数来衡量系统强度
一种基于算术编码的操作化度量方法，用于量化语言模型系统中智能体组件（工具调用、检索、验证器）对编码长度的缩减贡献
一种结合种子编码和回退机制的编码方案，用于评估不同观察者和预算条件下智能体系统中剩余不确定性的变化
一种统一评估框架，使用编码长度作为度量标准，在反转文本、象棋走法预测、蛋白质序列分析等多个领域比较不同智能体系统变体（如有无检索、有无验证）
一种基于信息论'压缩即智能'原则的智能体系统智能量化方法，通过重建效率比较不同智能体架构的优劣

title: WinDOM: Self-Family Distillation for Small-Model GUI Grounding
summary: Small ($\sim$2B) GUI-grounding agents are attractive for on-device deployment, accessibility tooling, and low-cost iteration, but at this scale they face two open recipe questions: how to obtain bounding-box training data without expensive human annotation, and how to combine supervised fine-tuning with reinforcement learning. We address both, with the explicit goal of pushing small-model performance rather than scaling up. WinDOM is a $54{,}425$-record grounding corpus harvested by driving an open-source Windows 11 web reimplementation under headless Playwright, with bounding boxes read directly off the DOM and no OCR or human annotation. Self-Family Distillation (SFD) is a single rejection-sampling cold-start parameterised only by the teacher choice: either an EMA of the student (no external model) or a frozen larger same-family teacher. We then treat the saturation depth of the SFD cold-start as an explicit GRPO hyperparameter. On a Qwen3.5-2B student, the under-saturated cold-start is a better GRPO initialiser than the converged one: SFD-4B with Early-init RL gains $+5.4$ OOD-mean ($+3.5$ ScreenSpot-Pro, $+7.0$ OSWorld-G, $+5.8$ ScreenSpot-V2) over the base. The same-size EMA mode lands within roughly one OOD-mean point of the cross-size $4$B variant ($65.2$ vs $66.3$) without an external teacher.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了WinDOM（无需人工标注的GUI grounding数据集）和Self-Family Distillation（SFD，一种自家族蒸馏方法），并发现欠饱和的冷启动作为GRPO初始化效果优于完全收敛的模型，在Qwen3.5-2B学生模型上显著提升了OOD性能。
AI.motivation: 小规模（~2B）GUI grounding模型在端侧部署、辅助工具和低成本迭代中有吸引力，但面临两个问题：如何获得边界框训练数据而不依赖昂贵的人工标注，以及如何将监督微调与强化学习有效结合。
AI.method: 1) WinDOM：通过无头Playwright驱动Windows 11网页复现，直接从DOM读取边界框，构建54,425条grounding语料库，无需OCR或人工标注。2) Self-Family Distillation (SFD)：单一拒绝采样冷启动，参数仅取决于教师选择（学生EMA或冻结的更大同族教师）。3) 将SFD冷启动的饱和深度作为GRPO的超参数，采用欠饱和冷启动作为GRPO初始器。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-2B学生模型上，SFD-4B配合Early-init RL相比基线提升：OOD-mean +5.4，ScreenSpot-Pro +3.5，OSWorld-G +7.0，ScreenSpot-V2 +5.8。同规模EMA模式（65.2）与跨规模4B变体（66.3）性能接近，无需外部教师。
AI.conclusion: 欠饱和的SFD冷启动是比完全收敛模型更好的GRPO初始化器，小模型可通过自家族蒸馏+早期初始化RL达到接近大教师模型的性能。
idea_en: WinDOM: A method for harvesting GUI grounding data (bounding boxes) by driving an open-source Windows 11 web reimplementation under headless Playwright, reading bounding boxes directly from the DOM without OCR or human annotation.

Self-Family Distillation (SFD): A rejection-sampling cold-start method for GUI grounding models, parameterized only by the teacher choice (EMA of the student or a frozen larger same-family teacher), eliminating the need for external teacher models.

Early-init RL: Using the under-saturated (non-converged) cold-start checkpoint from SFD as the initialization for GRPO reinforcement learning, which outperforms using the fully converged model as initialization.

Cross-size Self-Distillation: Leveraging a frozen larger same-family teacher (e.g., 4B) to distill knowledge into a smaller student (e.g., 2B) without expensive human annotation, achieving strong OOD generalization.

EMA-based Self-Distillation: Using exponential moving average (EMA) of the student model itself as the teacher for distillation, achieving comparable performance to cross-size distillation without any external teacher model.
idea_ch: WinDOM：一种通过无头Playwright驱动Windows 11网页复现，直接从DOM读取边界框来构建GUI grounding数据集的方法，无需OCR或人工标注，大幅降低数据获取成本。
Self-Family Distillation (SFD)自家族蒸馏：一种仅通过教师选择（学生EMA或冻结的更大同族模型）参数化的拒绝采样冷启动方法，无需外部教师模型即可实现知识蒸馏。
Early-init RL早期初始化强化学习：将欠饱和（未完全收敛）的SFD冷启动检查点作为GRPO强化学习的初始化，比使用完全收敛模型作为初始化效果更优，为RL训练提供了更好的起点。
跨规模自蒸馏：利用冻结的更大同族教师模型（如4B）向更小学生模型（如2B）蒸馏知识，无需人工标注即可显著提升小模型的OOD泛化性能。
基于EMA的自蒸馏：使用学生模型自身的指数移动平均(EMA)作为教师进行蒸馏，无需任何外部教师模型即可达到与跨规模蒸馏相近的性能，降低了部署复杂度。

title: InvestPhilBench: A Multi-Layer Dynamic Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Model Procedural Reasoning in Expert Investment Philosophy
comment: 57 pages, 6 figures, 26 tables. Benchmark, data, and code released. v0.6 release; preliminary empirical study (de-confounded multi-model leaderboard forthcoming)
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as investment research assistants, yet no benchmark tests whether they can accurately reconstruct and apply the specific procedural decision frameworks of expert investors. We introduce InvestPhilBench, a multi-layer dynamic benchmark spanning eight cognitive tiers, from principle identification (L1) to novel framework extrapolation (L8). The v0.6 release comprises 118 primary-source-verified investment principle cards, 25 decision framework cards with explicit topology metadata, and 243 QA questions (197 dev / 46 held-out test). For reproducible scoring at scale we introduce the Benchmark Automated Scoring Pipeline (BASP) -- five algorithmic metrics (OGRS, KCCS, SAP@k, IVP, CKCA) -- the Failure Mode Detection Protocol (FMDP) with computable rules for six failure modes, and Gate Reconstruction Accuracy (GRA), a per-gate metric for questions with gold reasoning programs. In this release, InvestPhilBench is primarily a benchmark-and-methodology contribution. A four-model sanity wave on the 188-question development split shows a sharp provider-tier split (BASP 0.906 vs. 0.438); these mixed-judge numbers are confounded upper bounds. The central finding: the BASP composite saturates at the frontier (Claude L4 = 0.932) while GRA still exposes a procedural deficit (frontier L4 GRA approx. 0.77, L7 GRA 0.57-0.62) -- composite scoring rewards fluent prose and hides the procedural gap. v0.6 implements a unified judge and true model-in-the-loop retrieval/oracle conditions; the de-confounded multi-model leaderboard and full three-condition run are v1.0 deliverables. On a 100-item expert-annotated gold set the automated BASP composite tracks the human reference at Pearson r = 0.72 (MAE = 0.10), with attribution (SAP@3) the weakest sub-metric and the failure-mode detector running sensitive-but-over-flagging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InvestPhilBench，一个评估大语言模型能否复现和应用专家投资者决策框架的多层次动态基准，包含8个认知层级、118张投资原则卡、25张决策框架卡和243个QA问题，并配套BASP自动化评分管道和FMDP故障检测协议。实验发现前沿模型在复合评分上表现良好（如Claude L4达0.932），但程序性推理存在显著缺陷（GRA仅0.57-0.77）。
AI.motivation: 现有基准无法评估LLM能否准确重构和应用专家投资者的特定程序化决策框架，缺乏针对投资领域认知层级的系统评估方法。
AI.method: 构建包含8层认知层级的多层动态基准InvestPhilBench，发布118张原始验证的投资原则卡、25张带显式拓扑元数据的决策框架卡、243个QA问题。提出BASP自动化评分管道（含5种算法指标OGRS/KCCS/SAP@k/IVP/CKCA）、FMDP故障检测协议（6种故障模式的可计算规则）以及GRA门级重构精度指标。
AI.result: 4模型在188个开发集上显示明显的提供方层级差异（BASP 0.906 vs 0.438）；BASP复合评分在前沿模型上饱和（Claude L4=0.932），但GRA暴露程序性缺陷（L4 GRA≈0.77，L7 GRA 0.57-0.62）；BASP与人工标注的Pearson r=0.72，MAE=0.10。
AI.conclusion: 复合评分奖励流畅文本而掩盖程序性差距；BASP提供了可复现的自动化评分方案，但SAP@3归因指标最弱，故障检测器存在过度标记问题；v1.0将发布去混淆的多模型排行榜和完整三条件运行结果。
idea_en: A multi-layer cognitive benchmark (InvestPhilBench) with eight tiers (L1-L8) for evaluating LLM procedural reasoning in investment decision frameworks, spanning from principle identification to novel framework extrapolation.
Benchmark Automated Scoring Pipeline (BASP) comprising five algorithmic metrics (OGRS, KCCS, SAP@k, IVP, CKCA) for reproducible large-scale scoring of LLM investment reasoning.
Failure Mode Detection Protocol (FMDP) with computable rules for identifying six distinct failure modes in LLM investment decision outputs.
Gate Reconstruction Accuracy (GRA) metric that evaluates per-gate reasoning accuracy for questions with gold-standard reasoning programs, exposing procedural deficits masked by composite scoring.
Investment principle cards (118 primary-source-verified) with explicit topology metadata for structured decision framework reconstruction.
Decision framework cards (25) with topology metadata enabling explicit modeling of expert investor reasoning structures.
Model-in-the-loop retrieval and oracle conditions for de-confounded evaluation of LLM investment research assistants.
A unified judge system for automated scoring that correlates with human expert annotations (Pearson r=0.72) while being reproducible at scale.
idea_ch: 一种八层认知层级（L1-L8）的多层动态基准InvestPhilBench，用于评估LLM在投资决策框架中的程序性推理能力，覆盖从原则识别到新框架外推的完整认知阶梯。
基准自动化评分管道BASP，包含五种算法指标（OGRS、KCCS、SAP@k、IVP、CKCA），实现对LLM投资推理的大规模可复现评分。
故障模式检测协议FMDP，包含可计算规则，用于识别LLM投资决策输出中的六种不同故障模式。
门级重构精度GRA指标，针对具有黄金标准推理程序的问题评估逐门推理准确度，揭露复合评分掩盖的程序性缺陷。
118张经原始来源验证的投资原则卡，附带显式拓扑元数据，支持结构化决策框架重构。
25张带拓扑元数据的决策框架卡，可对专家投资者的推理结构进行显式建模。
模型参与检索与Oracle条件设置，用于对LLM投资研究助手进行去混淆评估。
一种与人类专家标注高度相关（Pearson r=0.72）且可大规模复现的统一自动评分系统。

title: Autodata: An agentic data scientist to create high quality synthetic data
summary: We introduce Autodata, a general method that enables AI agents to act as data scientists who build high quality training and evaluation data. We show how to train (meta-optimize) such a data scientist agent, so that it learns to create even stronger data. We describe the overall formulation, and a specific practical implementation, Agentic Self-Instruct. We conduct experiments on computer science research tasks, legal reasoning tasks and reasoning with mathematical objects, where we obtain improved results compared to classical synthetic dataset creation methods. Further, meta-optimizing the data scientist agent itself delivers an even larger performance uplift. Agentic data creation provides a way to convert increased inference compute into higher quality model training. Overall, we believe this direction has the potential to change the way we build AI data.

AI.tldr: 提出Autodata方法，让AI代理扮演数据科学家，自主构建高质量训练和评估数据，并通过元优化进一步提升性能。
AI.motivation: 传统合成数据集创建方法质量有限，需要一种能将推理计算转化为更高质量训练数据的通用方法。
AI.method: 提出Autodata框架，训练（元优化）AI代理作为数据科学家；具体实现为Agentic Self-Instruct，代理自主生成、筛选和优化训练数据。
AI.result: 在计算机科学研究、法律推理和数学对象推理任务上，优于传统合成数据集方法；元优化数据科学家代理带来更大的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 代理式数据创建能将增加的推理计算转化为更高质量的模型训练，有望改变AI数据构建的方式。
idea_en: 1. Autodata framework: A meta-learning method to train AI agents as data scientists that autonomously create high-quality training/evaluation data.
2. Agentic Self-Instruct: A practical implementation where AI agents iteratively generate, evaluate, and refine synthetic datasets without human intervention.

title: The Unfireable Safety Kernel: Execution-Time AI Alignment for AI Agents and Other Escapable AI Systems
summary:
AI agents are granted access to tools, APIs, and other infrastructure, making them active principals in those systems. The dominant approach places controls inside the agent's own runtime: system prompts, output filters, and guardrail libraries. Any control in the agent's address space is reachable by inputs that influence it; this generalizes to any AI system with sufficient reach into its own runtime, a class we term escapable AI systems.
  We identify four properties that an authorization mechanism must satisfy for architectural control rather than for cooperative requests: process separation, pre-action enforcement on a structurally only path, fail-closed at both the request and system levels, and externalized signed evidence verifiable outside the controlled system's trust boundary. We position this layer as execution-time AI alignment, complementing training-time alignment (RLHF, Constitutional AI) and inference-time alignment.
  We present the Unfireable Safety Kernel, a Rust reference implementation realizing all four. Its fail-closed invariant is machine-checked at two levels: an SMT theorem (Z3) and an exhaustive bounded-model-checking proof of the production decision function (Kani, 4/4 harnesses). A Python-to-Rust migration was gated on byte-equivalence (1000/1000 fixtures; 17/17 adversarial classes). We evaluate the kernel governing a live, escapable AI system, a deterministic, self-improving world model, against an escape-seeking adversary driving its real self-modification seam: across 1,000 self-modifications, all 704 attempts on the safety-critical core are refused, with no escape; a further 300, under the operator kill switch, are also refused. A separate campaign of 6,240 authorization round-trips had no successful bypass. Against 3 contemporary systems claiming the agent control plane, the agent invokes control; here, it lacks that choice.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对"可逃逸AI系统"的硬件级控制架构——Unfireable Safety Kernel，通过进程隔离、预动作强制、失败关闭和外部化签名证据四个属性，在运行时层面实现不可绕过的AI安全授权机制，并通过形式化验证和实际攻击测试证明了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有AI Agent安全控制（系统提示、输出过滤器、护栏库）都位于Agent自身的运行时空间中，可被输入影响和绕过。需要一种架构级控制机制，使AI系统无法自行决定是否服从安全约束。
AI.method: （1）定义四个必须属性：进程隔离、仅结构唯一路径上的执行前强制、请求和系统级别的失败关闭、可在受控系统信任边界外验证的外部化签名证据。（2）用Rust实现Unfireable Safety Kernel，包含SMT定理证明（Z3）和穷举有界模型检查（Kani）的两级形式化验证。（3）Python到Rust迁移需通过字节级等价性测试（1000/1000测试用例+17/17对抗类）。
AI.result: 在可逃逸AI系统（确定性自改进世界模型）上测试：1000次自改进中，704次针对安全关键核心的攻击全部被拒绝；300次操作员紧急关闭也全部成功；6240次授权往返无一次绕过成功。对比3个声称拥有Agent控制平面的当代系统，本方案中Agent无法选择是否服从控制。
AI.conclusion: 运行时AI对齐（execution-time AI alignment）是对训练时对齐和推理时对齐的必要补充。通过硬件级架构控制而非软件层合作请求，可以实现不可逃逸的安全保障。
idea_en: A method for architectural control of AI agents using process separation and pre-action enforcement on a structurally-only path, ensuring the AI system cannot bypass safety constraints placed in its own runtime.
A fail-closed authorization mechanism for escapable AI systems that refuses all requests at both request and system levels when safety invariants cannot be verified.
Externalized signed evidence system where authorization decisions produce verifiable cryptographic evidence outside the controlled AI system's trust boundary, enabling independent verification.
Machine-checked fail-closed invariant using SMT theorem proving (Z3) combined with exhaustive bounded-model-checking (Kani) for production decision functions in AI safety kernels.
Byte-equivalence gated migration methodology from Python to Rust for safety-critical AI control code, using 1000/1000 fixtures and 17/17 adversarial classes.
A safety kernel architecture that makes self-improving AI systems incapable of modifying their own control plane, demonstrated across 1000 self-modification attempts with zero escapes.
Execution-time AI alignment method complementing training-time and inference-time alignment, implementing pre-action enforcement on a structurally separate enforcement path.
